title: Operations & Quality Assurance Manager
description:
Our company helps people trace their Canadian ancestry and prepare their Canadian citizenship applications. Behind every case is a family, a collection of important records, and a client trusting us to get the details right.



We’re looking for someone to take ownership of the people and processes that make that happen.



You’ll work directly with the founder and manage our current team of three case managers and one support agent. We bring on approximately 10–12 new cases each week, and we need someone who can keep the team organized, maintain high standards, and make sure applications are ready before they reach clients.



You’ll have real responsibility and the authority to act: set priorities, assign work, address performance issues, require corrections, and hold an application back when something needs fixing.



You’ll be responsible for:

- Leading the team day to day. Make sure everyone checks in, understands their priorities, and follows through. Give clear feedback and help people improve.

- Keeping cases moving. Track assignments, deadlines, research, document requests, and application preparation. Catch stalled cases and resolve blockers.

- Checking the work. Look at what has actually been completed, verify that it meets our standards, and follow up when something is missing or unclear.

- Reviewing final applications. Check names, dates, family relationships, supporting records, forms, and overall completeness. Return issues for correction and confirm they’ve been resolved before release.

- Improving how we operate. Turn recurring problems into better instructions, checklists, and training. We want your judgment and ideas.

- Keeping the founder informed. Provide a concise picture of progress, staff performance, quality issues, and decisions that need attention.



You’ll be a strong fit if you’ve already managed a team and been accountable for the quality of its work. You’re comfortable having a direct conversation when someone misses expectations, and you know how to follow that conversation with practical support and clear accountability.



You also enjoy detailed work. You notice when two documents disagree, ask good questions, and investigate before accepting an explanation.



Experience in legal support, immigration administration, insurance claims, mortgage processing, or another field involving detailed case files would be especially useful. Strong written and spoken English, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently are essential.



You’ll learn NorthClaim’s specific workflows and review standards during onboarding. Application review will initially happen alongside the founder, with independent responsibility increasing as you demonstrate accuracy.



This is an opportunity to have a visible impact on a small business. You’ll know the people you manage, work directly with the person making business decisions, and have room to shape how the operation runs. Success means a team that knows what to do, cases that keep moving, and clients receiving carefully reviewed work.



To apply, please send your résumé, earliest available start date, and a short Loom video of approximately 2–3 minutes answering:

1. What team have you managed, and what improved because of your leadership?

2. Tell us about a time you caught a mistake before it reached a client. How did you catch it, and what did you do?

3. What appeals to you about taking ownership of operations at NorthClaim?

A simple recording is perfect. We’re interested in how you think and communicate; there’s no need for slides or editing.

A working Loom video link is required. Applications without a Loom video will not be considered for an interview.

CRM activity

Property activity

Maintenance activity

Outstanding tasks

Completed tasks

We want someone who is proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership.



Once trained on our specific systems and processes, you should be able to recognize recurring responsibilities and handle them without waiting for instructions every day.



You should naturally:



Look ahead and anticipate what needs to be done

Follow up on outstanding tasks

Track deadlines without being reminded

We want someone who can eventually say:



"I noticed this needs to be done, so I took care of it."

title: Senior Copywriter & LinkedIn Personal Brand Strategist
description:
We’re a profitable, fast-scaling ecommerce business doing approximately USD $5M per month in revenue, and we’re hiring an exceptional copywriter to shape how our founder, company and products are presented to the world.



A major part of your role will be building the founder’s personal brand on LinkedIn. You’ll turn the daily journey of scaling an international ecommerce business into compelling content that builds authority, attracts talented people and makes ambitious professionals want to follow our company’s journey.



However, this is not only a LinkedIn role.



You’ll also write high-impact commercial copy across our business, including landing pages, product pages, recruitment campaigns, job descriptions and our future careers website.



This is not an entry-level position and full training will not be provided. You must already have proven experience growing either your own LinkedIn profile or the personal brand of a founder, entrepreneur or executive.



The role



LinkedIn and personal branding

- Interview the founder and extract valuable stories, lessons, opinions and business insights

- Turn conversations, voice notes and rough ideas into engaging LinkedIn posts

- Develop and manage the founder’s LinkedIn content strategy and calendar

- Write strong hooks, stories and educational content without sounding generic or artificial

- Identify interesting behind-the-scenes moments from daily business life

- Work with the founder and team to identify suitable photos and visual content

- Analyze performance and continuously improve topics, formats and writing styles

- Build an audience of ecommerce professionals, operators, entrepreneurs and high-performing talent

- Strengthen our employer brand and make exceptional people interested in working with us



You will not simply receive finished ideas to rewrite. You must be able to recognize strong content opportunities, ask intelligent questions and proactively extract the best ideas.



Commercial copywriting

- Write and improve landing pages and product pages

- Develop headlines, offers, hooks and product positioning

- Help build and write our careers website

- Write recruiting pages, job descriptions and candidate-facing campaigns

- Support ad copy, advertorials,
 copy and other high-impact projects

- Use customer research, reviews and performance data to improve messaging and conversions



Who we’re looking for: 



Proven LinkedIn experience

- You have successfully grown your own LinkedIn profile or managed the personal brand of someone else.



You must be able to show:



- Profiles you have worked on

- Posts you personally wrote

- Audience and follower growth

- Engagement or performance results

- Your specific contribution to the strategy and execution



Exceptional English copywriting

- Your written English must be immaculate. You can write naturally, clearly and persuasively without clichés, filler or generic corporate language.



You can adapt your style depending on the objective: authentic and personal for LinkedIn, persuasive for a product page and ambitious but credible for recruiting.



Strong commercial understanding

- You understand that a good copy must do more than sound nice. It should create interest, communicate value, overcome objections and move people to buy, apply or take action.



Strong interviewing and storytelling skills

- You can take rough thoughts or ordinary daily events and turn them into compelling stories with a strong hook, clear structure and valuable takeaway.



Ownership and judgment

- You proactively identify ideas and weak messaging instead of waiting for instructions. You also know how to communicate impressive business results without making the founder or company appear arrogant or overly promotional.



What we provide



- Direct access to the founder of a fast-growing ecommerce company

- A constant stream of real business stories, lessons and behind-the-scenes material

- Significant ownership over the founder’s personal brand and company messaging

- The opportunity to work across LinkedIn, ecommerce, conversion copywriting and employer branding

- A high-performance environment where strong work is recognized



Logistics and compensation

- This is a remote position.

- Compensation will depend on your experience, portfolio and proven results.



How to apply



Please send us:

- Your CV

- Links to LinkedIn profiles you have grown

- Three LinkedIn posts you personally wrote

- Evidence of audience growth, engagement or other measurable results



Applications without clear evidence of LinkedIn growth and strong copywriting will not be considered.

title: Production Operations Manager - USA Construction / Home Services - Residential
description:
PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POSTING, IF YOU DON'T YOU WILL BE SCREENED OUT AUTOMATICALLY



We are an established residential home services company based in the Minneapolis–St. Paul area of the United States, and we are looking for an exceptional Production Operations Manager to take ownership of the day-to-day logistics behind our projects.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, comfortable making decisions, and capable of managing a constantly changing production schedule without needing to be told what to do every step of the way.



You will work remotely but will be responsible for coordinating U.S.-based subcontractor crews, customers, schedules, field staff, and production systems. This is a key operational role within the company, and we are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of the business.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Schedule projects and coordinate job starts

• Coordinate subcontractor crews and maintain an accurate production schedule

• Create, send, and manage work orders

• Recruit, screen, and onboard new subcontractors

• Maintain an active subcontractor roster and track availability

• Continuously build a strong pipeline of qualified subcontractors

• Make sure we have enough production capacity for upcoming work

• Monitor projects from scheduling through completion

• Solve day-to-day production and scheduling problems

• Communicate with subcontractors, customers, salespeople, and field staff

• Keep our CRM accurate and up to date

• Track project status, delays, issues, and completion

• Coordinate warranty work, punch-list items, and smaller service projects

• Coordinate with U.S.-based field staff and help ensure they are being utilized efficiently

• Coordinate quality-control visits and project inspections

• Follow up on outstanding production issues until they are fully resolved

• Build and improve systems and processes that make production easier to manage and scale



A major part of this role will be recruiting and managing our subcontractor network. We do not view recruiting as something that should only happen when we urgently need additional workers. The Production Operations Manager should continuously develop relationships with qualified subcontractors so we have enough capacity as production volume changes throughout the year.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone with previous experience in operations, construction, home services, property management, logistics, dispatching, project coordination, or a similar environment.



The ideal candidate:



• Is extremely organized and detail-oriented

• Can manage many projects and moving pieces at the same time

• Is comfortable making decisions and solving problems independently

• Communicates extremely well in written and spoken English

• Is confident communicating with U.S. customers, contractors, and field workers

• Is comfortable holding people accountable

• Takes ownership of problems instead of waiting for someone else to solve them

• Can prioritize quickly when several issues happen at once

• Learns new software and systems quickly

• Is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where schedules can change

• Has experience working remotely for a U.S.-based company

• Has experience coordinating subcontractors, technicians, field crews, or other distributed workers

• Is looking for a long-term position with an opportunity to take on greater responsibility



We are specifically looking for someone who understands the difference between completing tasks and owning an outcome. You should be able to look at the entire production pipeline, determine what needs attention, communicate with the right people, and make sure things get done without requiring constant direction.



If we have projects starting next week, you should already be confirming subcontractor availability. If capacity is becoming tight, you should already be recruiting. If a customer or production issue develops, you should take ownership of getting it resolved. If the same type of problem keeps occurring, we want you to help improve the system so it stops happening.



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time, long-term position with a typical workload of approximately 40 hours per week. Some weeks may be lighter and others may require additional time depending on production volume and seasonality. Because you will be coordinating with U.S.-based customers, subcontractors, and field staff, you must be available primarily during U.S. Central Time business hours, approximately 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Time, Monday through Friday. This means working overnight hours in the Philippines, so please only apply if you are comfortable maintaining this schedule long term.



COMPENSATION



Compensation is $2,000–$2,500 USD per month depending on experience, ability, and fit. There is significant opportunity for increased compensation and responsibility for someone who performs well and becomes a key long-term member of the company.



TO APPLY



Please include the following with your application:



1. Begin your application with the words "I AM YOUR NEXT PRODUCTION MANAGER" so we know you carefully read the entire posting.

2. Briefly describe your experience managing operations, projects, contractors, logistics, or schedules.

3. Describe a situation where something went wrong operationally and explain how you handled it.

4. Tell us about your experience working U.S. business hours or overnight shifts.

5. Tell us about any experience you have managing or coordinating subcontractors, technicians, field crews, or other workers.

6. Include a short video introduction explaining your background and why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position.



Candidates who pass the initial application review will be invited to complete a practical operations exercise before moving forward in the hiring process.



We are looking for someone exceptional, dependable, proactive, and interested in becoming a long-term part of our company.

title: Social Media Marketing
description:
Social Media Strategy & Growth Audit

We are looking for an experienced Social Media Manager / Strategist to come in on a project basis and audit our existing organic social media system.

We already have an established content process. We are not looking for someone to simply create posts or build us another content calendar.

The purpose of this project is to identify:

What we are already doing well

What we are missing

What can be improved

What opportunities we are not using

What current platform features, strategies or systems we should know about

What we should test next

What We Already Do

We currently:

Have a structured content guide/planner with the purpose and direction of each piece of content

Track and analyse best- and worst-performing content

Rewrap successful content rather than constantly creating completely new ideas

Revisit underperforming content to identify holes and test improved versions

Analyse hooks, retention, watch time, reach, engagement, saves, shares, followers and other performance signals

Review content by day and posting time

Currently see stronger performance commonly around 4pm–7pm, while recognising that posting within this window does not automatically make content perform

Use different content objectives and categories

Use organic content alongside warm-ups/community engagement

Research market language and audience problems

Use content to support lead generation rather than chasing views alone

Adapt and improve content based on analytics

Have systems for scripting, captions, CTAs and content production

What We Want You to Audit

1. Overall Social Media Strategy

Review our complete organic social media system and identify anything important that is missing, unnecessary or could be improved.

We want to know:

Are we using each platform correctly?

Are there opportunities or platform features we are not using?

Is our current strategy aligned with how platforms currently distribute content?

What would you change if you were managing this account?

2. Audience & Distribution

Audit who our content is actually reaching.

We want to understand:

Are we reaching the right audience geographically?

Are we reaching Melbourne / local prospects strongly enough?

Why does some content get distributed internationally?

What signals can help platforms understand who our intended audience is?

Are there account, content or behavioural signals influencing the wrong audience?

How can we improve the quality of reach, not just total reach?

3. Social SEO & Search Discovery

Audit how discoverable our content and profiles are through search.

Review:

Profile/name/bio optimisation

Keywords

Captions

On-screen text

Spoken keywords/video content

Titles/headlines

Locations/geotags

Search intent

Platform-specific SEO

Whether hashtags have any useful role for us

How Instagram,
 and 
 search should influence our content

Give us a clear social-search system we can continue using.

4. Content Packaging

Audit whether strong ideas are being packaged in the strongest possible way.

Review:

Hooks

First frames

Reel covers/thumbnails

Titles

Video length

Pacing

Editing

Caption relationship to the content

CTA placement

Format choice

Carousels vs Reels vs static content

Talking-head vs demonstration vs client content

Whether content is being structured appropriately for each platform

5. Content Rewrapping System

Review our current process of reusing and improving existing ideas.

We want to know:

Are we rewrapping correctly?

How many variations should we test before retiring an idea?

What should actually change between versions?

When should we change the hook versus the body versus the format?

How do we distinguish a bad topic from bad execution?

How do we avoid content becoming repetitive?

Are there originality/distribution issues we need to consider?

6. Analytics & Testing

Audit how we currently analyse content.

Identify:

Important metrics we are not tracking

Metrics we are giving too much weight to

Better ways to compare content fairly

How to separate topic performance from posting-time performance

How to test days and posting times properly

How to test hooks, formats, length, thumbnails and CTAs

What benchmarks we should establish internally

How many posts or tests are required before making a decision

We want a simple testing methodology our team can keep using.

7. Content-to-Lead Tracking

We do not only want views.

Audit how effectively social media contributes to:

Profile visits

DMs

Comments/conversations

 leads

Clarity Call enquiries

Workshop enquiries

Website visits

Bookings

Customers

Show us how to better identify which content actually contributes to leads and customers.

8. Community & Engagement Strategy

Review how we use:

Comments

DMs

Replies

Stories

Community interaction

Local groups/warm-ups

Audience questions

Client conversations

Identify opportunities to turn engagement into meaningful conversations and leads without making the account feel overly promotional.

9. Competitor & Market Audit

Review relevant:

Melbourne businesses

Movement/mobility/wellness creators

Local service businesses

High-performing accounts in adjacent industries

We want to know:

What they are doing that we aren't

Formats they are using

Topics they are winning with

How they create local relevance

What we should test without simply copying competitors

10. Profile & Conversion Audit

Review the journey from someone discovering a piece of content to taking the next action.

Audit:

Content → Profile → Bio → CTA → Link → DM / Website / Booking

Identify friction, missing information or opportunities to improve conversion.

11. Platform Features & Current Best Practices

Teach us anything current that our team may not know.

This should include relevant new or underused:

Instagram features

 features

TikTok features

Analytics tools

Testing tools

Search tools

Creator/business tools

Recommendation/distribution features

Collaboration opportunities

Local discovery opportunities

We specifically want someone who stays current with platform changes rather than repeating generic social-media advice.

12. Final Recommendations

At the end of the audit, provide:

Keep Doing

What is already working and should remain unchanged.

Improve

What we are doing correctly but could execute better.

Stop

Anything unnecessary or hurting performance.

Start

Important things we are currently not doing.

Test

Specific experiments to run over the next 30–90 days.

Teach

Anything our team needs to understand or learn so we can execute it ourselves after the project finishes.

Final Deliverable

We want a concise audit that tells us:

Where we are now

What we are doing well

What we are missing

What needs improving

What we should test

What new opportunities exist

What our team should learn

What you would do next if this were your account

We do not need generic advice.

The goal is to bring in an experienced outside perspective, improve our existing system, teach us anything we are missing, and then give our internal team a clearer system to continue executing.

title: Skilled E-Commerce Graphic Designer
description:
We’re looking for a high-performance E-Commerce Graphic Designer to join our team part-time (20h/week), with the opportunity to transition into a full-time role in the future. We’re a fast-growing DTC brand selling premium cleaning products in the US. We move fast, test aggressively, and care about results — not excuses. If you love turning creative ideas into scroll-stopping ads and beautiful e-commerce graphics, this is for you.



Who are we?

We’re a young, ambitious e-commerce company selling premium cleaning products in the US through our brand Shiny Wipes. In the last two year we managed to hit multiple 7 figures in yearly revenue and aim for hitting 8 figures within the next 12 months. Our small but dynamic team is hungry for success, and we value continuous improvement, accountability, and respect in everything we do. If you're looking for more than a typical 9-5 job, eager to take on challenges, and ready to play a key role in our growth, you’ll fit right in.



What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less — and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following core values:

"work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning — every problem is an opportunity to grow. Opportunity to transition into a full-time role based on performance and company needs.

title: Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
About the company 



We are a digital marketing agency with a Philippine team, a portfolio of around 200 lead generation websites, six retainer clients, and a few new projects in development.  





About Guy 



Guy is the founder. He also carries a Head of Marketing and sales role for our anchor client, which means his day runs across three worlds — the anchor client, his own company's existing business, as well as his new projects. He's direct, he moves quickly, and he travels quite frequently. His day can shift, and some priorities can slip through the cracks. Too much lands in his inbox and calendar. His meeting notes can accumulate, and tasks could get buried. He ends up doing a lot of work that can otherwise be delegated to this team. He doesn't like to use a project management tool. 



Your job in one paragraph 



You run Guy's day so he can run the company. Catch everything that lands in his inbox, sort it, act on what you can, and hand him only what needs his brain. Analyze and organize his meeting notes, so that his deliverables and priorities are aligned. You will not be given a task list every morning. You will build it. 



What a normal day looks like 



Your shift covers Spain's business morning, so your afternoon is his morning. When he opens his laptop, a short brief is already waiting. What came in overnight, what today's meetings need, and the three things that matter most. His inbox has been sorted. During the overlap you handle scheduling, chase replies, prep documents, and take things off his plate as they come up. There may be invoices, subscriptions, travel, expenses, document filing, and vendor accounts to handle.  



You will be delegated work that needs to get done to push the business forward to be completed in the gaps. This will include items such as generating more lead gen websites (using a self service and relatively easy tool), posting on LinkedIn for himself or on behalf of clients, reviewing videos for podcasts he is producing for errors and quality issues, as well as doing outreach to assist in business development functions, primarily by writing short
s, DMs, and other small messages. 



Before you log off, he gets an end of day summary and a calendar for tomorrow that's already confirmed. When applying, please make sure to make the subject of the message say "Coffee" to let us know you have read the entire listing.



Who does well in this role 



- You've supported a founder, executive, or business owner before, for at least five years, and you owned things without being told. 

- You write clean, plain English, fast. Half this job is writing on Guy's behalf. You should be highly proficient in English, both written and verbal.

- You make decisions. When two things conflict and he's unreachable, you pick one, act, and tell him why. 

- You tell the truth early. If you broke something, he hears it from you before he finds it himself — we test for this harder than anything else. 

- You keep a system. Tasks, deadlines, and open loops live somewhere you can show on screen in thirty seconds. 

- You're comfortable with Microsoft Outlook 365 apps, project management tools, picking up new technology, and using AI to enhance your output. 

- You don't have multiple jobs or conflicting priorities. 

- You can roll up your sleeves, and even get out of your comfort zone, to get things done. 

- You have stable power and internet, and a backup plan for both. 

- Having some design skills is a plus, but not a requirement (hopefully you have a good eye)

- You must be very comfortable with Technology and AI



 

How to apply 



Tell us: Who was the last person you supported? What did you own completely? How would you help Guy be more organized? Please use the OnlineJobs system when applying. We will be looking at your application history and job history carefully, as we want someone who is dedicated and has stability more than just a person in a seat. This is a big hiring decision and will not be made overnight.

title: Senior Bookkeeper (Canadian Bookkeeping)
description:
Senior Bookkeeper (Canadian Bookkeeping) 



Location: Remote, Philippines-based

Employment type: Full-time [via independent contactor]

Schedule: EST hours or align with Canadian business hours



About Us

We're a growing, fully cloud-based Canadian accounting and tax firm serving small to medium-sized businesses and professionals across Canada. We take a proactive, advisory-driven approach. We don't just process numbers. We use clean, accurate books to help our clients make smarter decisions and reduce their tax burden.



## The Role



We're looking for a Senior Bookkeeper with hands-on Canadian bookkeeping experience to own full-cycle bookkeeping across a diverse portfolio of SMB clients. You'll be technically strong in QuickBooks Online and/or Xero, comfortable with cleanups and migrations (if needed), and interested in using automation to make the work faster and more accurate. You'll work closely with our tax and accounting team, and your work will feed directly into the tax planning and advice our clients rely on.



## What You'll Do



- Manage full-cycle bookkeeping for multiple SMB clients across different industries: bank and credit card reconciliations, AP/AR, categorization, payroll entries, and month-end close

- Lead cleanup projects on messy or backlogged books, including catch-up bookkeeping, correcting errors, and reconciling historical periods

- Handle software migrations, such as moving clients from desktop QuickBooks or other platforms to QuickBooks Online or Xero, with clean opening balances and data integrity

- Prepare and reconcile GST/HST/PST/QST filings and related accounts

- Set up and maintain client files, charts of accounts, bank feeds, rules, and integrations

- Build and improve automations and workflows using tools like Dext/Hubdoc, Zapier, bank rules, and other bookkeeping apps to cut manual work

- Prepare accurate, on-time financial statements and hand off clean, tax-ready books to the tax team

- Communicate clearly with clients and internal team members: follow up on missing documents, ask the right questions, and flag issues early

- Keep documentation and processes organized so work is easy to review and hand off

- Spot risks, inconsistencies, and opportunities in client books and escalate them to the tax and accounting team



## What We're Looking For

Required

- Proven experience in Canadian bookkeeping, including GST/HST/PST, payroll remittances, and CRA-related compliance

- 4+ years full-cycle bookkeeping experience serving **multiple, diverse clients**, ideally SMBs

- Strong hands-on experience with **QuickBooks Online and/or Xero**; the more platforms you know, the better

- Demonstrated experience with **cleanups and migrations**

- Excellent written and verbal English communication

- Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail

- Strong work ethic, reliability, and ownership of your deliverables

- Comfortable working independently in a remote, cloud-based environment



**Nice to have**

- Experience with other tools such as Sage, FreshBooks, Wave, or QuickBooks Desktop etc

- Familiarity with automation tools (Zapier, Make, Dext, Hubdoc, etc.) and a habit of finding ways to streamline your own work

- Experience working with a Canadian accounting or tax firm

- Professional bookkeeping credentials or coursework (e.g., a bookkeeping certification or accounting degree)



Our Commitment Expectations (Please Read Before Applying)

We're building a long-term team, and we're investing in training, onboarding, and career growth for the right person. Because of that, THIS IS NOT A FIT FOR YOU IF:



You are looking for a short-term role

Have a history of frequently changing jobs or clients after only a few months

Plan to take on other full-time roles or stack multiple clients alongside this one



This is a full-time, exclusive position. We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us for the long haul, gives us their full focus during working hours, and takes ownership of their portfolio. Please only apply if this describes you.



## What Makes You a Great Fit



- You're tech-forward and like finding smarter ways to get things done

- You catch the small things others miss

- You communicate proactively instead of waiting to be asked

- You care about clients' outcomes, not just closing out tasks

- You take pride in your work and hold yourself to a high standard



## What We Offer



- Fully remote work

- Exposure to a variety of Canadian SMB clients and industries

- A collaborative team with CPA-led tax and advisory expertise

- Compensation: [salary range]

- [Benefits, e.g., paid leave, HMO, 13th month, equipment allowance, growth path]



## How to Apply



Send your resume/CV and answers to the following questions below:



1. Canadian bookkeeping and software experience

Walk us through your Canadian bookkeeping experience. Include the software you've used (QuickBooks Online, Xero, others) and years on each, the types of businesses you've served, how many clients you handled at once, and how you've handled GST/HST/PST and payroll remittances.



2. Cleanups and migrations

Describe one cleanup project and one software migration you've completed. For each, tell us the state of the books at the start, the steps you took, the challenges you hit, and the outcome.



3. Technology and automation

Which tools or automations have you used to make bookkeeping faster or more accurate (e.g., bank rules, Dext, Hubdoc, Zapier, Fathom)? Give one specific example of a workflow you improved and the result.



4. Do you have night shift experience and able to work EST / Canadian hours?

title: Pixar-Style AI Animated Ad Creator: Facebook & Instagram Ads
description:
Mon–Fri | $650–$850/month + performance bonuses



I run a small DTC operation with the resources to scale further. We create AI-generated, Pixar-style 3D animated video ads, including musical ads where the characters sing. I'm looking for someone very comfortable using AI tools to create high-quality animated ad creatives fast.



The creatives you make run as paid ads on Meta:
 and Instagram feeds, reels, and stories.



This is NOT a "make a short film" job. This is a marketing-first animation and editing role. Every shot, every lyric, every character expression exists for one reason: to stop the scroll and drive the click. If a beautiful scene doesn't help the ad convert, it doesn't go in.



HOW WE OPERATE

We run three stores. One is a US-made product, long-term brand. The other two are testing stores where we validate new dropshipping products.



This matters for how you'll work. One week I might need a few creatives for the US brand. The next week the focus shifts entirely to a testing product. The workload moves with demand. The workflow stays the same.



To be clear: this is NOT a role where I expect 50 creatives a week for each store. What I need is someone who can switch between stores without losing quality and move fast and loose when we're testing something new.



THE STYLE WE MAKE — READ THIS CAREFULLY

We make two formats:



Pixar-style animated ads. 3D animated characters (people, animals, talking products, ingredients, even body parts) that tell a quick story: problem, reaction, product, result. Think expressive faces, soft lighting, big emotional beats, and humor.

Pixar-style musical ads. The same animated characters, but the message is delivered as a short, catchy song. The hook is the first line of the song, and the product benefit is the chorus people remember.



In practice that means:



Expressive, likeable characters with big readable emotions

Character consistency: the same character must look the same in every shot

Fast pacing, with a new shot every 2–3 seconds and no slow establishing scenes

Big readable captions burned in (for musical ads, lyric-style captions), because most people watch with sound off

The product shown clearly and doing the thing being talked or sung about

For musical ads: cuts and actions timed to the beat, and clean lip sync to the vocals

The first 2 seconds must stop the scroll or nothing else matters



The hard part with AI: keeping characters consistent across shots, getting convincing lip sync on animated faces, and making the song catchy instead of generic. Prompting and editing your way to something that feels like a real animated short (not a random AI clip) is the core skill I'm hiring for.



All characters must be original. No actual Disney/Pixar characters, logos, music, or anything that could be mistaken for official Pixar content. We want the style, not their IP.



MUST KNOW HOW TO PROMPT AND USE:

Higgsfield (image/video generation: characters, scenes, animation)

Suno or similar (AI music and songs for musical ads)

ElevenLabs (character voices and voiceovers)

A lip-sync tool (HeyGen, Higgsfield, or similar) for animated characters

ChatGPT / Claude (for prompting and lyrics)

Notion (our business operates in Notion; simple use)

Google Drive (where we organize and save videos/assets)

CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro



YOU SHOULD UNDERSTAND:

Pixar-style 3D character design and prompting

Character consistency across shots

AI music generation and writing catchy, ad-friendly lyrics

Lip sync for animated characters

Syncing edits to music

Hooks, pacing, captions, and product shots

Meta ad creative testing

Fast creative variations

Working within a defined brand style when the project calls for it



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

We will give you the script or lyrics and a reference video, competitor ad, or idea, and you'll turn it into a Pixar-style animated or musical ad ready to test on
 and Instagram.



You should be able to move fast, follow instructions, and improve creative quality over time.



REQUIREMENTS:

Must speak English fluently

Must have a portfolio with animated or AI-generated character work

Must be comfortable with AI tools and willing to learn new ones as they appear

Must be organized and able to work inside Notion

Must be available Monday to Friday. No weekend work expected.

Must be able to adapt between different products, brands, and styles

Must understand that this is a performance creative role, not just an animation role



WHAT YOU GET:

$650–$850/month depending on experience and speed

Performance bonuses on ads that win and scale

Long-term role with room to grow

title: Motion & Media Support
description:
Motion & Media Support

Full-time | Remote (Philippines) | US$280 per week | Monday–Friday



An Australian fashion / lifestyle DTC brand is looking for a Motion & Media Support hire to lead video editing across the marketing team's content output.



This role sits within Marketing & Creative and works closely with the Social/Content team, the founder, and campaign leads to turn raw footage into fast, engaging, on-brand video — from campaign launches through to everyday social and organic content.



The Opportunity

Pay: US$280 per week (fixed advertised rate; US$7.00 per hour).

Arrangement: Full-time remote contractor engagement, 40 hours per week.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm (aligned to Australian business hours).

Start: As soon as practical. Please include your earliest start date and any notice period.

The advertised rate is fixed. Please only apply if you are comfortable with the compensation and schedule.



What you'll be responsible for

1. Campaign content — Cutting reels from campaign launch content, with a focus on hero products.

2. In-house face to camera — Cutting and editing in-house face-to-camera content (founder/talent or Social team) into publish-ready pieces.

3. Influencer content — Cutting and editing influencer content, splitting multi-look reels into individual posts for organic and paid use.

4. Stop motion — Creating stop-motion content for social hype and brand-building filler content.

5. Reactive / lower-lift content — Fast-turnaround editing of raw or lookbook footage into stories and in-the-moment posts, prioritising speed over polish.

6. Paid ad creative — Cutting multiple hook/variation edits of the same footage for A/B testing across paid social, and resizing winning organic content for paid placements.

7. Event and activation content — On-the-ground and same-day editing from activations, launches, and store openings/events for near real-time posting.

8. UGC, customer and employee content — Sourcing, editing, and repackaging customer, creator, and employee-generated content into social- and paid-ready formats.

9. Cross-channel repurposing — Adapting core footage across social, EDM/email banners/GIFs, website product and campaign video, and long-format channels.

10. Templates and batching — Building reusable cut-down templates and presets (intros, product callouts, transitions) to support higher-volume, faster-turnaround content.



Must-haves

- Fluent English (spoken and written) — required. You must communicate clearly with an Australian marketing and creative team.

- Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating social-first video editing, ideally fashion, lifestyle, or DTC retail.

- Software proficiency: Adobe, CapCut, Figma, Canva; After Effects for motion graphics, titles, and typography.

- Platform know-how across 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9 formats.

- Motion graphics within existing brand templates and visual identity (not needing full creative direction for every asset).

- Comfortable with high content volume and fast turnaround in a deadline-driven environment.

- Asset management: organising, logging, and archiving raw footage from shoots, influencer sends, studio days, and campaigns.

- Collaboration: working closely with digital and Social/Content teams, following briefs, and turning around feedback quickly.

- Sound design & music licensing awareness for social (royalty-free / trending-sound workarounds).

- Basic photography/videography for supplementary content on set, in office, or in store.



How to apply

Apply with your CV, portfolio/reel link, and brief answers:

1) Confirm fluent spoken and written English for an Australian creative team (Yes/No).

2) Share your best social-first video portfolio/reel (fashion/lifestyle/DTC preferred).

3) Which tools do you use day-to-day (Adobe, CapCut, After Effects, Figma, Canva, others)?

4) Describe a high-volume or fast-turnaround edit you owned end-to-end.

5) Confirm you can work Mon–Fri 9:00am–5:00pm AU hours at US$280 per week. Earliest start date?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a brief screen and meet the team. Applications are being reviewed now.

title: Experienced Senior Project Manager (Amazon FBA | Full-Time)
description:
# Join a Fast-Growing E-Commerce Brand Based in Singapore



We’re a fast-growing Singapore-based Amazon FBA brand looking for a highly capable **Amazon E-Commerce Director / Senior Project Manager** to help us scale.



This is not a coordinator role.



We’re looking for someone who can **see the big picture while being highly meticulous with the details**. You should be comfortable managing people, analysing data, improving systems, identifying problems early, and taking ownership of execution.



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



You’ll oversee a team of around 6 people across listings, design, and operations.



You’ll manage product launches and Amazon projects from planning through execution.



You’ll review sales, profitability, advertising, inventory, conversion, rankings, and other key data to identify opportunities and risks.



You’ll coordinate suppliers, freight forwarders, inspection agents, inventory planning, production, and shipping.



You’ll review Amazon listings carefully, including keywords, images, backend data, attributes, variations, dimensions, weights, and size tiers.



You’ll maintain accurate dashboards and reporting so management always has a clear view of the business.



You’ll identify bottlenecks and recurring problems, then improve the systems behind them rather than repeatedly fixing the same issues.



## We Want Someone Data-Driven



You should naturally ask questions like:



Why did sales increase or decrease?



Where are we losing margin?



Which products are underperforming and why?



Are we ordering too much or too little inventory?



What are the biggest risks over the next 30, 60, or 90 days?



We do not want someone who simply reports numbers.



We want someone who can **interpret the data, identify what matters, and recommend what we should do next.**



## Attention to Detail Matters



Amazon is a business where small mistakes can become expensive quickly.



Wrong dimensions, incorrect listing data, inventory mistakes, inaccurate spreadsheets, or missed shipping timelines can directly affect profitability.



You should be naturally **careful, structured, meticulous, and willing to double-check important work before execution.**



## Think Like a Director



We want someone who can gradually operate at a director level.



You should be able to understand where the business is going, what the team should prioritise, what risks management should know about, and which processes need improvement.



You should not need to be told every single thing to do.



If you see a problem, raise it.



If you see an opportunity, propose it.



If something does not make sense, question it.



## Managing People



You’ll manage and coordinate a team of around 6 people.



You should be able to set clear expectations, assign responsibilities, track progress, identify bottlenecks, and hold people accountable without simply chasing for updates.



## AI and Technology



We actively use AI to improve research, listings, analysis, reporting, operations, and project management.



AI is a tool, not a replacement for thinking.



We expect you to use it to work faster and make better decisions while still applying your own judgment and checking the output carefully.



## Tools You’ll Use



Amazon Seller Central

Google Sheets and Docs

Notion

Helium 10

DataDive

Zoom

AI tools and internal systems



## What We’re Looking For



At least **5 years of relevant experience**, ideally in Amazon FBA or e-commerce operations.



Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and backend workflows.



Experience with listings, inventory, product launches, and operational processes.



Strong analytical skills and confidence working with spreadsheets and dashboards.



Excellent attention to detail.



Experience managing people and multiple projects.



Strong problem-solving and communication skills.



Commercial awareness and an understanding of how decisions affect revenue, profit, cash flow, and growth.



Able to work independently without constant supervision.



Proactive, open-minded, and comfortable challenging assumptions when something can be improved.



## Working Hours



Monday to Friday

12 PM to 10 PM Singapore time

1-hour break

Remote

44 hours per week



## How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction and why you’re a good fit.



Clear details of your Amazon FBA experience.



Your most recent role and what you personally owned.



Examples or references to Amazon brands or projects you have worked on.



Examples of teams or projects you have managed.



A short video introduction if possible.



Please also tell us about **one Amazon or e-commerce problem you identified through data, what you discovered, and what action you took.**



## Important



Only candidates with genuine Amazon FBA experience will be considered.



This role is for someone who can already operate independently and contribute at a senior level.



We’re looking for someone who can become a **key operator in the business: someone we can trust with the numbers, the people, the details, and the bigger picture.**

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor — Rewired Kids & Live Loud



Location: Fully Remote (must have some overlap with Mountain Time / Colorado business hours)

Job Type: Full-Time, Monthly Retainer — $700–$1,000/month depending on experience, with a paid trial period at a lower rate before moving to full retainer



Reports To: Content Marketing Manager, with final sign-off from the Owner



About Us



Rewired Kids and Live Loud are family-focused brands with a real storefront and a growing online presence. We're a fast-paced office and online business, and we thrive on speed, accuracy, and details. We need an editor who can turn raw footage into content that actually stops the scroll, fast, and stays true to our brand every single time.



Trial Period



This role starts with a paid trial period at a lower monthly rate. Once you've shown you can turn around high-quality edits fast, stay on brand without heavy direction, and manage your own workflow, the retainer moves to the full rate.



Top Priorities

Short-form content. Reels, TikToks, and ad creative that are built to hook, hold attention, and convert.

Long-form to short-form. Taking longer videos and pulling out the moments worth clipping, cutting, and repurposing across platforms.

Thumbnails and static images. Clean, on-brand graphics that support the video content.

Speed without sacrificing quality. Using AI tools to move faster and stay consistent, not to replace your eye or your creativity.

What You'll Do

Edit short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, and
, including Reels, ad creative, and organic posts

Take long-form video and cut it down into multiple short-form pieces that each stand on their own

Design thumbnails and simple supporting images that match our brand every time

Use AI tools, including Claude, to speed up captioning, scripting support, and staying on-brand without slowing down output

Use CapCut as your primary editing tool for fast-turnaround, social-native content

Keep every project organized in Notion so nothing gets lost, footage is easy to find, and anyone on the team can see where a project stands

Turn one filming session into a minimum of two weeks of usable content across platforms

Watch for what's actually working (hooks, pacing, formats) and bring ideas for what to try next, not just execute what's handed to you

Keep a sharp eye on brand consistency: fonts, colors, tone, and pacing should feel like us every time

Hit deadlines consistently. Content that's late doesn't help us

What We're Looking For

Available to start right away and commit full-time, this isn't a role we can wait around on

Available to overlap with Mountain Time (Colorado) business hours, even working fully remote

Non-negotiable, hands-on experience with Claude, Notion, and CapCut. This isn't a "willing to learn" role, you need to already be fluent in all three

A real portfolio of short-form content, especially Reels, TikToks, or ad creative that shows you understand pacing and hooks

Experience turning long-form footage into short-form clips that don't feel like leftovers

Speed, accuracy, and efficiency. We move fast and need someone who can keep up without cutting corners

Sharp attention to detail. Brand consistency, timing, captions, and quality all matter every time. If you've read this far, message us with the word GORILLA before you apply, we pay attention to who pays attention

A keen eye for what makes people watch, stop scrolling, and stay engaged. You should have real instincts for what's unique and entertaining, not just technically correct

Strong organizational habits. You should be able to manage multiple projects and versions without anything getting lost or mixed up

Comfortable using AI tools to move faster, not as a replacement for your own editing judgment

Nice to Have

After Effects or motion graphics experience

Basic sound design or audio cleanup skills

Experience editing for health, wellness, family, or parenting-focused brands

How to Apply



Message your portfolio or reel examples, especially anything short-form, ad-focused, or repurposed from long-form content. Show us edits you're proud of and tell us why they worked.

title: Shopify E-Commerce VA – Product Research, Listings & Operations
description:
SHOPIFY E-COMMERCE VA – PRODUCT RESEARCH, LISTINGS & OPERATIONS



Part-Time or Full-Time | 20–40 Hours/Week | Long-Term Remote Role



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are building a new Shopify e-commerce business and are looking for a reliable, resourceful and detail-oriented E-Commerce Virtual Assistant based in the Philippines to grow with us long-term.



Your role will mainly involve:



• Product research and sourcing

• Shopify product listings

• Order fulfilment and shipment monitoring

• Customer support

• General e-commerce operations



You do NOT need to be an expert in every area or know every platform we may use.



We are looking for someone with good e-commerce fundamentals who is organised, learns quickly, takes initiative and is comfortable researching solutions independently.



==============================

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

====================



1. PRODUCT RESEARCH & SOURCING



Especially in the beginning, a major part of your role will be researching potential products for us to sell.



You may:



• Research interesting, trending or potentially profitable products

• Search AliExpress, CJdropshipping, 1688, Alibaba and other suppliers

• Research competitors, marketplaces and social media

• Compare different suppliers

• Compare product prices, shipping costs and delivery times

• Check supplier reviews and reliability

• Find alternative or backup suppliers

• Calculate estimated product and shipping costs

• Organise your research clearly in Google Sheets

• Recommend promising products for review



You will NOT be expected to make the final decision on what we sell.



Your role is to research, compare options and make useful recommendations.



2. SHOPIFY PRODUCT LISTINGS



For approved products, you will help prepare them for our Shopify store.



Tasks may include:



• Create and edit Shopify product listings

• Improve product titles and descriptions

• Upload and organise product images

• Create product variants and options

• Set prices according to our instructions

• Organise products into collections

• Perform basic image editing when required

• Check listings carefully before publishing

• Make sure product pages look professional on desktop and mobile



You may use tools such as ChatGPT, Canva, PhotoRoom or similar tools to help you work efficiently.



3. ORDERS & FULFILMENT



As the store starts generating sales, you will also help manage customer orders.



Tasks may include:



• Process Shopify orders

• Submit orders to the correct supplier

• Check customer information and product variants

• Monitor order fulfilment

• Check tracking information

• Follow up on delayed shipments

• Handle out-of-stock supplier issues

• Identify orders that require attention



We may use AliExpress, DSers, CJdropshipping and other suppliers or fulfilment platforms.



4. CUSTOMER SUPPORT



You will help answer customer enquiries professionally through
 or chat.



Typical enquiries may include:



• Order status and tracking

• Delivery delays

• Address changes

• Cancellations

• Returns and refunds

• Damaged or incorrect items

• Missing items

• Product questions



We will provide guidelines for handling common situations.



More serious or unusual cases can be escalated to the owner.



5. SUPPLIER & PRODUCT INFORMATION



From time to time, you may also help:



• Contact suppliers

• Request product information

• Request relevant product documents or certifications when required

• Organise supplier information

• Flag products that may have unusual safety, regulatory or import requirements



You are NOT expected to make legal or compliance decisions.



If something appears unclear or potentially risky, simply flag it for review.



==============================

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

=====================



Ideally, you have some previous experience with:



• Shopify

• E-commerce or dropshipping

• Product research or sourcing

• Product listings

• Order fulfilment

• Customer service



Experience with AliExpress, CJdropshipping or DSers is a strong advantage.



Experience with 1688, Alibaba, Canva, Photoshop, ChatGPT or other e-commerce tools is useful but NOT required.



You do not need experience with every platform listed above.



MORE IMPORTANTLY, WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO:



• Has good written English

• Pays strong attention to detail

• Is organised and dependable

• Is comfortable using Google Sheets

• Can research independently

• Can learn new software quickly

• Communicates problems early

• Takes ownership of their work

• Can suggest solutions instead of only reporting problems

• Is comfortable using 
 and WhatsApp for day-to-day communication

• Is open to using time-tracking software such as Time Doctor for work-hour tracking





We value initiative.



If you discover a problem, we would love someone who can say:



“I found this issue, checked a few possible solutions, and I think this is the best option because…”



Rather than simply:



“There is a problem. What should I do?”



==============================

WORKING ARRANGEMENT

===================



We are open to either:



• Part-Time – approximately 20 hours/week



OR



• Full-Time – approximately 40 hours/week



This will depend on your experience, availability and suitability for the role.



We may also start at approximately 20 hours per week and increase your hours as the business grows.



This is intended to be a LONG-TERM position, not a short-term project.



Working hours can be reasonably flexible, although some overlap with Singapore business hours may occasionally be required.



As the store grows, some short order or customer-support checks outside normal working days may also be required.



==============================

COMPENSATION

============



Rate to be discussed based on experience and skill level.



Please include your EXPECTED HOURLY RATE IN USD when applying.



We are open to paying more for someone with strong relevant experience who can work independently and take greater ownership of the role.



There will also be opportunities for increased responsibilities and compensation as the business grows.



==============================

HOW TO APPLY

============



Please start your application with:



ECOM VA 2026



This lets us know that you have read the full job post.



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself



2. Your CV/resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile



3. A short summary of your Shopify/e-commerce experience



4. Any experience you have with product research, dropshipping or sourcing



5. Which e-commerce platforms or tools you have used



6. Examples of stores, product listings or similar work you have done, if available



7. Your expected hourly rate in USD



8. Whether you prefer:

   • Approximately 20 hours/week

   • Approximately 40 hours/week

   • Or are open to either



9. Your current availability



You do NOT need to write a long cover letter.



==============================

HIRING PROCESS

==============



STEP 1 – APPLICATION



We will review your experience, application and previous work.



STEP 2 – SHORT ONLINE SCREENING



Selected candidates will be invited to complete a short Google Form.



This will help us better understand your approach to:



• Product research

• Supplier comparison

• Customer service

• Problem solving

• E-commerce operations



STEP 3 – PAID TRIAL



Final shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a PAID trial project involving tasks similar to the actual job.



This may include product research, supplier comparison, preparing a sample product listing and handling simple customer-service or fulfilment scenarios.



We are looking for someone reliable, resourceful and interested in building a long-term working relationship as the business grows.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Construction Estimator & Project Support VA
description:
We are a boutique, family-run residential building company based in NSW, Australia. We’re looking for an experienced Construction Estimator & Project Support Virtual Assistant to work closely with our Construction Manager.



This isn’t a general admin VA role. We need someone who genuinely understands residential construction, can confidently read architectural and engineering plans, and has experience with estimating, BOQs, take-offs, job costing and project administration.



A major part of the role will involve working within Wunderbuild to help us maintain accurate estimates, project costs, schedules and documentation from tender through to construction.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of a small, driven team and take on greater responsibility as they become familiar with our projects, systems and way of working.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



The primary focus will be supporting our Construction Manager with estimating, BOQs, take-offs, quoting, project scheduling, job cost tracking and WHS compliance, together with ongoing construction administration.



ESTIMATING & COST MANAGEMENT

- Prepare detailed BOQs, take-offs, estimates and cost plans

- Interpret architectural plans, specifications and engineering documentation

- Assist with pricing projects from plans and project documentation

- Build and maintain estimating templates, cost libraries and standard items

- Review and update pricing using supplier and subcontractor quotations

- Track supplier and subcontractor pricing and identify outstanding quotes

- Identify potential scope gaps, omissions, cost risks and discrepancies

- Assist with variations, revisions and estimate updates as projects evolve

- Maintain accurate budgets and job costs throughout construction

-Ensure estimates are consistent with the documented project scope



PROJECT & CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT

- Set up and maintain projects within Wunderbuild

- Assist with preparation and maintenance of construction schedules

- Keep project information, budgets, costs and variations accurate and current

- Maintain organised and accurate project records and documentation

- Assist with subcontractor and supplier coordination and follow-ups

- Assist with management of our HazardCo WHS system, including contractor compliance

- Assist with
 management and project follow-ups

- Prepare, organise and maintain project documents and files

- Provide general construction administration support as required



REQUIREMENTS



We are specifically looking for someone with construction estimating experience, rather than a general Virtual Assistant.



You should have:

- Proven experience as a Construction Estimator, Quantity Surveyor, Construction Administrator or similar role

- Previous experience working with an Australian residential construction or building business

- Strong understanding of residential construction methods, terminology, sequencing and costs

- Experience preparing BOQs, take-offs, estimates and cost plans

- Ability to confidently read and interpret architectural, structural and engineering drawings

- Experience with job costing, variations and construction administration

- Experience working with supplier pricing and subcontractor quotations

- Strong numerical accuracy and exceptional attention to detail

- Strong organisational and time-management skills

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Ability to work independently, follow tasks through and meet deadlines

- Reliable internet connection

- Comfortable working directly with a busy Construction Manager



SOFTWARE & SYSTEMS



Experience with the following would be highly regarded:

- Wunderbuild experience – highly regarded

- HazardCo

- Dropbox

- Google Workspace

- Xero or other construction/accounting software



If you have strong Australian residential construction estimating experience but have not used all of our systems, we are happy for the right person to learn them.



WORKING HOURS

- Initially 20 hours per week, with the potential to increase

- Flexible working hours, however regular overlap with Australian Eastern business hours will be required

- We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position, not a short-term project



RATE

AUD $10/hour, with scope to increase based on experience and performance.



HOW TO APPLY



Please apply through onlinejobs.ph only. DO NOT send resumes via
, WhatsApp, Messenger or other avenues



Please include:

- “Builder’s Backbone” in the subject line to confirm attention to detail

- If you are already proficient in Wunderbuild, add “WB” after “Builder’s Backbone” in your subject line

- A brief introduction about yourself

- Details of your experience working with Australian residential construction or building companies

- Your experience with BOQs, take-offs, estimating, job costing and construction administration

- Details of your experience using Wunderbuild and any other construction estimating/project management software

- Examples of similar projects, estimates or BOQs you have worked on

- Your experience with HazardCo, Dropbox, Google Workspace and/or Xero

- Your usual working hours and availability

- Briefly describe the process you would use to prepare a BOQ from a set of architectural and structural drawings



We’re looking for someone who can become a trusted part of our team — someone who is organised, accurate and proactive, understands construction and takes pride in getting the details right.



If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.



Please note: Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a practical skills assessment using Australian residential construction plans to demonstrate their ability to interpret drawings, prepare take-offs and understand construction scope.



If you do not have experience reading and working with residential construction plans, please do not apply.

title: Finance Manager — Xero Accountant for Australian Fashion Wholesale
description:
Finance Manager — Xero Accountant for Australian Fashion Wholesale

Full-time | Remote (Philippines) | US$450 per week (~US$1,950/month) | Mon–Fri Sydney business hours



Adminworks is recruiting a Finance Manager (Xero Accountant) for an established Australian fashion wholesale and brand-management business.



This role is equal parts phone and spreadsheet. You will own the day-to-day finance function across accounts receivable, accounts payable, invoicing, reconciliations, cash-flow forecasting and management reporting. Just as importantly, you will proactively call customers to collect overdue payments and build strong working relationships with them.



This is not a passive bookkeeping role. If your approach to collections is sending an automated statement and waiting, this role will not suit you.



We need someone comfortable picking up the phone, discussing overdue invoices professionally and persistently, and giving the Directors clear visibility over cash and financial performance.



ABOUT THE BUSINESS

Our client is an established Australian fashion wholesale and brand management business representing a portfolio of recognised fashion and lifestyle brands across domestic and international markets, working with a large number of small-business wholesale customers.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Accounts receivable and collections

• Proactively call Australian customers regarding overdue invoices and outstanding information.

• Build genuine customer relationships and understand how individual accounts pay and communicate.

• Resolve payment discrepancies and follow commitments through to completion.

• Maintain the debtor ledger and accurately allocate payments.

• Chase sales figures and other information needed for commission invoicing.



Finance operations

• Own the day-to-day finance function in Xero.

• Manage accounts payable, receivables and customer invoicing.

• Complete bank, credit-card, debtor, creditor and balance-sheet reconciliations.

• Manage month-end processes and coordinate with external accountants.

 • Maintain accurate, current financial records.



Cash flow and reporting

• Maintain a rolling cash-flow forecast and identify potential issues early.

• Prepare clear weekly and monthly management reports.

• Report on written orders, invoiced sales, cash received, receivables, payables and expenditure.

• Track performance by brand, customer and market.

• Reconcile operational information from order placement through to delivery, invoicing and payment.

• Meet regularly with the Directors and explain financial performance clearly.



Systems and improvement

• Improve the structure and use of Xero, including accounts, tracking categories and reporting.

• Build practical Excel reporting, reconciliation and cash-flow templates.

• Identify opportunities to improve or automate finance workflows using technology and AI.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• At least five years of accounting, bookkeeping or finance experience.

• Experience owning the end-to-end finance function of a small or medium business.

• Advanced, hands-on Xero experience.

• Demonstrated experience collecting overdue payments by phone.

• Excellent spoken English and a professional, personable phone manner.

• Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, reconciliations and reporting templates.

• Experience preparing cash-flow forecasts and management reports.

• Confidence presenting financial information to business owners or senior leaders.

• Strong accuracy, organisation and follow-through.

• Reliable internet, backup connectivity and a quiet environment for customer calls.

• Based in the Philippines and available full-time Monday–Friday, Sydney business hours.



HIGHLY REGARDED

• Previous experience supporting an Australian business.

• Familiarity with Australian GST and BAS processes.

• Experience in fashion, wholesale, retail, distribution or another product-based business.

• Experience with commission or agency revenue models.

• Accounting, finance or commerce degree, CPA or equivalent.

• Power Query, Power BI, finance automation or practical AI experience.



ENGAGEMENT & BENEFITS

 • Starting rate US$450 per week (~US$1,950/month).

• Permanent, full-time engagement with a single client — Adminworks handles your onboarding, HR and payroll. Performance review at 6 months.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include all of the following:

1. Your current CV.

2. A short summary of the finance functions you have personally managed in Xero.

3. An example of a difficult overdue account you successfully collected. Tell us how overdue it was, what actions you took and what happened.

4. An example of a cash-flow forecast or management report you have built and regularly maintained.

5. Confirm: Philippines-based, fluent spoken English, full-time Sydney hours at US$450/week.

Please use “FINANCE + PHONE” as the subject of your application.



Generic applications will not be prioritised.



Note: Adminworks is the employer of record (EOR) for this engagement.

title: ClickUp Operations & Data Analyst
description:
I am looking for a back-end operations specialist to own the health of our systems. You'll make sure no client or team member falls through the cracks, keep workflows and automations running, and turn daily data into decisions. You'll start by learning our systems end-to-end, documenting them, and supporting our current operations lead, then grow into owning operations outright.



This is a hands-on, behind-the-scenes role. You won't just delegate work. You'll do the work and make the system better every week.



What You'll Do



Monitor client and staff communications. Stay on top of activity across clients and team members, spot red flags early (a client going quiet, a staff member slipping, an unresolved issue), and act on them before they escalate.

Own the pipeline. Track every client from onboarding through retention and make sure nobody is missed, stalled, or forgotten.

Run daily data reviews. Monitor KPIs across sales, placements, retention, and performance, and deliver a weekly report covering what the data says and what we should do about it.

Manage ClickUp. Build and maintain workflows, assign tasks across departments, set deadlines, and make sure work actually gets completed.

Maintain automations. Monitor CRM and workflow automations, catch failures fast, and fix them or escalate them.

Document everything. Build and maintain SOPs for every back-end process so no knowledge lives in one person's head.

Improve systems with AI. Use AI tools to cut manual work, speed up reporting, and improve accuracy.



What You Bring



3+ years in operations, RevOps, or business analytics.

Strong ClickUp experience, including workflows, automations, dashboards, and task management at scale.

CRM experience, with GoHighLevel strongly preferred.

Notion experience, which is a plus for supporting system migrations.

Real data skills: spreadsheets, dashboards, spotting trends, and turning numbers into recommendations.

Hands-on use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in daily work.

Zapier, Make, or similar tools are a plus.

Obsessive attention to detail. You notice the client who hasn't responded in 10 days or the team member whose updates stopped, and you make a move before anyone asks.



An owner mentality: you execute, you follow through, and you don't wait to be told.

First 90 Days

Days 1–30: Learn every back-end system and gain full access to it. Start the SOP library.

Days 31–60: Own the daily data review and weekly KPI report. Have zero missed clients.

Days 61–90: Ship at least 2 data-backed system or automation improvements. Be able to run operations independently.



Please send your CV/Portfolio and short audio/video about your experience.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
FastAid is a first aid kits and consumables designer, importer and wholesaler based in Sydney, Australia. We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Graphic Designer to join our fast growing, friendly and vibrant team full time.



This is a full-time work from home role, with generous salary inclusive of 20 days annual leave p.a., detailed training and on-boarding, along with annual visits to our office Sydney, Australia paid for.



The Graphic Designer is responsible for bringing FastAid's brand to life visually, delivering high-quality, on-brand artwork and creative assets across both print and digital media. Creating and maintaining product artwork, preparing production-ready files, and supporting the marketing team with design for campaigns and collateral — always with an unbeatable eye for detail and consistency with our brand guidelines. Also responsible for editing and producing video content for marketing and product use, and keeping all design and video assets clean and methodically filed.



Expert-level skills in the Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator) are essential, with experience in video editing and production (e.g. Premiere Pro / After Effects) highly regarded. Must have a strong understanding of design and brand principles, and the ability to work to deadlines across multiple concurrent requests.



The role consists of four key areas;



1. Product artwork

2. Production-ready file preparation

3. Marketing design support

4. Video editing and production



Key attributes required:



- Always positive and energetic, friendly, and down to earth

- Always adds value and goes the extra mile on every design request – delivers an awesome brand experience

- Always finds creative solutions that stay true to the brand

- Actions design requests fast and gets things done quickly

- Always follows through on promises made and meets deadlines

- Seeks out opportunities to elevate the quality and impact of FastAid's visual brand

- Has a genuine passion for great design and visual storytelling

- Runs by systems and processes (file structure, brand guidelines) however remains flexible and creative

- Takes responsibility – acknowledges mistakes and fixes them fast

- Active listener with a desire to learn

- Takes the initiative and is proactive



We are looking for someone who can start full time quickly - ideally in the next 2-3 weeks.



Hours 7 or 8am to 4 or 5pm Sydney time, Monday to Friday.



Salary depends on level of experience and fit for the role.



For more information on the role, and to find out more about FastAid and our team, please submit a copy of your CV/resume and a video introduction of yourself to
