title: Remote Marketing & CRM Operations
description:
Are you a detail-oriented, tech-savvy Virtual Professional who enjoys working behind the scenes to keep systems clean, connected, and reliable?



We’re looking for a proactive VP of Backend Operations & CRM Systems to support a high-performing service business by maintaining accurate data flow across HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, systems-minded, comfortable troubleshooting platform issues, and able to help leadership pull accurate reports on leads, appointments, and revenue by source.



This is not a strategy role. The focus is on backend operations, data accuracy, CRM cleanup, reporting support, and workflow efficiency.



What You’ll Do



You’ll support day-to-day backend operations by helping ensure the client’s tools are properly set up, connected, and producing clean, reliable data.



CRM, Reporting & Data Management

• Review and clean up HubSpot data to ensure leads, appointments, deals, and revenue are accurately tracked.

• Help build and maintain HubSpot reports that leadership can easily pull and trust.

• Check that data from CallRail, web forms, Vendo, and Arrivy maps correctly into HubSpot.

• Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent lead source data and help correct it.

• Maintain clean deal records, contact records, and source attribution where needed.



CallRail, RingCentral & Source Attribution Support

• Review CallRail tracking numbers and confirm they are assigned to the correct lead sources, such as Google Ads, LSA, organic, referral, or outbound campaigns.

• Help clean up source attribution issues where outbound calls are incorrectly tagged under sales reps rather than the proper source categories.

• Support workflow improvements between CallRail and RingCentral to reduce platform-switching friction for the call center team.

• Document issues, patterns, and recommended fixes clearly.



Platform & Workflow Support

• Review the flow of information from HubSpot to Arrivy, Vendo, and back to HubSpot.

• Help troubleshoot minor system issues and coordinate with platform support teams when needed.

• Assist with routine Webflow content updates and minor website maintenance.

• Clearly document processes, updates, and recurring tasks so the team has reliable SOPs.



Admin & Communication Support

• Communicate clearly with the client, team members, and vendor/platform support teams.

• Provide regular updates on progress, blockers, and completed tasks.

• Use AI tools responsibly to improve documentation, reporting, and written communication.

• Maintain organized records, task lists, and process guides.



Who We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, and comfortable working across multiple systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you should be confident in learning platforms, checking integrations, and spotting data inconsistencies.



You may be a great fit if you:



• Have strong English communication skills, especially in written updates and documentation.

• Are detail-oriented and can spot inconsistencies in data, reports, workflows, and CRM records.

• Are tech-savvy and comfortable learning tools like HubSpot, CallRail, RingCentral, Arrivy, Vendo, and Webflow.

• Have experience with CRM management, reporting, lead tracking, or sales operations support.

• Can follow instructions carefully while also thinking ahead and identifying potential issues.

• Are proactive, resourceful, and willing to explore possible solutions before escalating.

• Can communicate blockers clearly and ask thoughtful questions when context is missing.

• Are comfortable working in a backend support role with limited customer-facing responsibilities.

• Can maintain confidentiality when handling client, customer, sales, and revenue-related data.



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



• HubSpot CRM, pipelines, properties, workflows, reports, or dashboards

• CallRail tracking numbers, call source attribution, or lead source cleanup

• RingCentral or other VoIP/call center platforms

• Webflow content updates or website maintenance

• Sales operations, marketing operations, or CRM administration

• Process documentation, SOP creation, or backend operations support

• Google Sheets, Excel, or reporting/data cleanup tasks



Tech & Infrastructure Requirements: To ensure a smooth and efficient remote work experience, applicants must have:

• Intel i5 10th Gen or AMD Ryzen 5 (or higher)

• Minimum 8GB RAM

• Device (laptop or PC) must be less than 3 years old

• Stable internet: 50–100 Mbps, with a backup connection

• Quality webcam, mic, and headset

Screenshots of your device specs and an internet speed test will be required upon application.



Why You’ll Love Working with Claud?

• Paid holidays & PTO

• HMO (after 1st year)

• Family Medical Incentive

• PAG-IBIG & referral incentives

• Weekends off

• Free learning sessions & fun company events

• Supportive, growth-driven remote community



Let's Get to Know You: Please include your answers to the following in your application :

1. In one paragraph, tell us about yourself.

2. What are your key strengths that would help you excel in this role?

3. What challenges do you foresee in this role?



Don’t just look for a job - build a meaningful career filled with freedom, balance, and the support you deserve.



Apply today!

title: Compliance Reporting & Invoicing VA | iTrade / Xero
description:
Apply through:



Role Overview



Candidates with a trades or construction admin background and hands-on experience with job management platforms (iTrade, Simpro or similar) will be prioritised for this role.



A family-run fire protection compliance business in Western Sydney needs a full-time Virtual Assistant to take over the repetitive compliance reporting and admin load, freeing the Operations Manager to focus on higher-value work. Compliance reporting alone currently consumes 15-20 hours of her week. The role starts with foundational data entry (test sheet preparation) and grows into defect reporting, invoicing, standard quoting, and client and tenant
 correspondence.



Success looks like a VA who reaches real autonomy within a few weeks, documents their own processes as they learn them, and can eventually own reporting and standard quoting end-to-end without needing constant check-ins.



What You'll Own



Test Sheet Preparation (Your Starting Point)



Prepare test sheets ahead of scheduled inspections by copying assets into the existing Google Sheets template (built-in formulas and pass/fail dropdowns)

Learn the compliance language and workflow of the business through this repeatable, detail-focused task



Compliance Reporting & Defect Documentation



Take raw inspection data recorded by field technicians on-site and compile it into formal defect reports

Clean up and format reports so they are ready for review and sign-off

Package finished reports using DocuSign before they go to clients

Learn the process live over several sessions, with full training provided



Invoicing & Quoting



Prepare invoices in iTrade once a job or report is signed off (flows through to Xero)

Once confident, prepare standard quotes from iTrade's preset pricing for common defects such as replacing extinguishers or smoke alarms

Non-standard or complex quotes stay with management



Client & Tenant Communication



Monitor and reply to ad hoc tenant booking enquiries by
 (roughly 2-3 per day)

Handle general correspondence with tenants, strata managers and clients

Review the last 2-3 months of inbox history early on to learn the business's language and common issues

Inbound phone calls may be introduced at a later stage



Document & Records Management



File incoming PDFs and council letters into the correct client folders

Keep the master compliance tracking spreadsheet up to date with due dates and report deadlines



Scheduling (Later-Stage Task)



Support routine scheduling of inspections across technicians and subcontractors

Keep scheduling data current in iTrade



Systems & Documentation



Work across iTrade, Xero, Simply Book, DocuSign and Google Workspace

Document each task as an SOP as you are trained on it, and review SOPs periodically



What We're Looking For



Experience



Prior experience in a compliance-driven, detail-heavy admin role

Trades, construction or field-services background strongly preferred, as it shortens onboarding

Fire protection experience is not required; full training on standards and defect terminology is provided



Communication Skills



Strong written English for tenant, strata manager and client correspondence

Confident, professional phone manner (phone work is not part of the initial scope, but may be introduced later)

Able to triage and respond to ad hoc enquiries calmly without needing everything spelled out



Technical Proficiency (Core Requirements)



Confident manipulating and cleaning structured data in Google Sheets or Excel, which is core to test sheets and defect reporting

Comfortable with invoicing workflows (iTrade and/or Xero)

Exposure to job or scheduling platforms (iTrade, Simpro or similar) is a plus

Comfortable working across multiple platforms (six currently), some of which may change as the business consolidates its systems



Organisational Skills



Able to bring structure and consistency to a high-volume, recurring task

Keeps track of where information lives across several systems without letting anything slip



Non-Negotiables



Detail-obsessed: catches inconsistencies in compliance data before they reach a client

Fast learner who can absorb "why this is a defect" explanations and apply them consistently

Proactively autonomous: does not wait to be told what's next and reaches independent ownership within weeks

Documents processes as they learn them

Discreet and trustworthy: confidentiality is essential, as you will handle sensitive compliance data tied to buildings and tenants

Comfortable with a structured communication rhythm: a morning WhatsApp message with the day's priorities and an end-of-day summary

Collegial team player, comfortable joining a close, family-run team

Comfortable with a workflow that may shift as the business reviews its tech stack



Working Arrangements



Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8:00am-4:00pm AEST (Philippines-based, 2 hours behind AEST)

Reports day-to-day to the Operations Manager, with the Director as a secondary reporting line



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of a function that sits at the centre of the business, with a clear path from data entry to reporting, invoicing and standard quoting

Full live training via screen-shared sessions, recorded so you can revisit them and don't need to keep asking

Work where accuracy matters: your reports protect buildings and the people in them

A structured, supportive communication rhythm rather than being left to guess

A friendly, close-knit family business where your input on systems and processes will be valued

To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction. It helps us shortlist quickly: [insert application form link:

What you'll do

title: Full-Stack Developer (AI-Fluent) — Build the Software That Runs Our Business
description:
TYPE: Full time, long term

SALARY: AUD $20 per hour (approx. AUD $3,450 per month at 40 hours/week)

HOURS: 40 hours per week

SCHEDULE: Overlap with 9am to 5pm Sydney time (roughly 7am to 3pm Manila time).

                     Some flexibility, but we need you online with the team most of the day.



ABOUT US

We're an Australian ecommerce group doing around $10M AUD a year across two brands: A Man & His Cave (pool tables, arcade machines, kegerators, man-cave gear) and Rumpus (made-to-order leather furniture).



We don't buy software. We build it. Our CRM, our operations tools, our reporting, our marketing systems are all things we're building ourselves, with AI in the loop. We're looking for one developer to take ownership of that.



This is a long term role. We're not looking for a project freelancer. We want someone who stays, learns the business, and owns this software for years.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS JOB

Our founder builds fast. He'll have a working prototype by the end of the day, put together with AI, and it will do roughly the right thing.



What it won't be is finished. It won't handle the edge cases. It won't be structured so the next person can extend it. It won't survive real data and real users for six months.



That's your job. You take things from "it works" to software we can actually run a business on. You'll spend as much time finishing and hardening as you do building from scratch, and that's the point.



WHAT YOU'LL BUILD



1. Our CRM (the priority, already underway)

   We're replacing Salesforce with our own. Rep desks, lead routing, call and
 ingestion, ad attribution from Meta and Google, commission logic. Your first job is getting it finished and used daily by the sales team.



2. Connecting our marketing tools

   Klaviyo, Meta, Google Ads, our own campaign systems. Making them talk to each other and to the CRM.



3. Joining our data together

   Shopify, Salesforce, Aircall,
, ad accounts, inventory. They all hold a piece of the truth and none of them agree. We want one place where they do.



4. Operations tools

   Purchasing and reorder engines, stock cover, backorder allocation, shipping, install scheduling. What our ops team uses to d
 what to buy and ship.



5. Dashboards people actually use

   Sales performance, cash flow, commission, KPIs per team. Real reporting off Postgres, not spreadsheets.



6. Creative and AI systems

   Asset libraries, briefing pipelines, internal AI agents in Slack and on our websites, MCP servers, Claude API features.



7. Our two Shopify stores

   Theme and front-end work, landing pages, and replacing the paid Shopify apps we currently rent with our own.



REQUIRED SKILLS

- TypeScript / JavaScript, React, Next.js

- PostgreSQL and SQL you can write well

- Building and consuming REST and GraphQL APIs

- Strong front-end design sense. These tools get used all day. If one is ugly or slow, people go back to spreadsheets and your work was wasted.

- Confident with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar)

- Good written English. You'll work directly with the founder every day.



NICE TO HAVE

- Shopify: Liquid, Admin GraphQL API, Functions, webhooks

- Anthropic / Claude API, MCP servers, AI agent patterns

- Experience building internal business tools or dashboards



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Someone genuinely full stack, comfortable from database to pixel

- Someone who knows the difference between code that runs and software that is finished, and has the discipline to close that gap

- Someone we can hand a messy business problem to, not a written spec

- Someone who tells us when something will be late, before it's late



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

You work directly with the founder. No project managers, no tickets sitting in a queue for a week. You will watch the thing you built get used by real people the same week you built it.



We use AI heavily and we want you to. You're not competing with it. You're the person who architects it properly, reviews what it produces, ships it, and owns it when it breaks.



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application (see below)

2. Short interview call

3. Paid trial task, so we both know it's a fit

4. Offer. Rate reviewed at three months.



HOW TO APPLY

Please do not send a generic application. We read every one and we bin the copy and paste ones. Send us your answers for the following questions using this link: 



1. Two live links to things you've built, and exactly what you did on each.

   Working products, not just GitHub repos. Internal tools and dashboards count for more than marketing websites.

2. One thing you shipped using AI tools, and what it changed about how you work.

   Be specific.

3. In a few sentences: tell us about a time you inherited something half built.

   What did you have to fix before it was genuinely ready for real users?

4. Use the word SLATE on the last question under the BACKGROUND SECTION so we know you read this properly.



Everyone who answers all four properly will get a reply.

title: Operations Manager – Luxury Vintage Bags Business
description:
IMPORTANT: Please start your application with the word “VUITTON”.



We are a Japan-based company specializing in luxury vintage products, particularly vintage Louis Vuitton.



We are currently developing a new business in the Philippines and are looking for a reliable and proactive Philippines Operations Manager who can help us build and manage the local operation.



Our planned business model is:



Japan sourcing → Philippines → Local repair → Live selling → Customer → Sales



The Japanese side will be responsible for sourcing and purchasing products in Japan.



Your role will be to build and manage the business operation in the Philippines.



Your responsibilities will include:



• Researching and finding reliable local luxury bag repair businesses

• Contacting repair businesses, requesting quotations, comparing prices and services, and negotiating when necessary

• Managing and tracking repair jobs, deadlines, costs, and quality

• Researching the Philippine market for vintage Louis Vuitton and other luxury products

• Researching actual local selling prices and customer demand

• Finding and contacting potential livestream sellers / live selling hosts

• Building relationships with reliable sellers and local business partners

• Coordinating live selling operations

• Managing inventory received from Japan

• Coordinating local delivery and customer communication

• Tracking sales, expenses, payments, and inventory

• Preparing regular reports for the Japan-based director

• Identifying problems and proposing practical solutions

• Taking responsibility for completing tasks independently



This is NOT simply a virtual assistant position.



We are looking for someone who can think like a business operator.



You will be expected to research information, contact real businesses, communicate with people, compare different options, negotiate when necessary, make recommendations, and take responsibility for results.



IMPORTANT PART OF THIS POSITION:



We are currently testing whether this business model can work successfully in the Philippines.



We do NOT want someone who simply agrees with our business idea.



If you believe that our business model has problems, risks, or is not profitable, we want you to tell us honestly.



Please give us your opinion about:



1. What do you think about this business model in the Philippines?

2. What do you think are the biggest opportunities?

3. What do you think are the biggest risks or problems?

4. What would you improve or change?

5. If you were responsible for the Philippine operation, what would you do first?

6. What would your plan be for the first 30 days?



We value honest opinions, practical thinking, research ability, communication skills, and problem-solving more than simply agreeing with us.



If you are hired, we plan to start with a small test of approximately 10 products.



You will gradually be given responsibility for different areas of the business, for example:



Week 1:

Research local repair businesses and contact potential repair partners.



Week 2:

Research and identify strong livestream sellers and contact potential candidates.



Week 3:

Research local market prices, customer demand, and competitors.



Week 4:

Help create a practical plan for selling the first 10 products.



The exact tasks may change depending on what we learn from the market.



We want to build this business together with someone who can identify problems, test ideas, and improve the business based on real results.



We are looking for a long-term working relationship with the right person.



TO APPLY:



Please start your application with:



“VUITTON”



Then briefly answer the following:



1. Where are you currently located in the Philippines?

2. What management, operations, or business experience do you have?

3. Have you worked with local businesses, suppliers, repair shops, or other partners?

4. Do you have experience with e-commerce, livestream selling, social media selling, or luxury products?

5. What do you think about our business model?

6. What would you improve or change?

7. What would you do during your first 30 days?

8. Why are you interested in this position?

9. What is your expected hourly rate or monthly compensation?



Please do not simply give a generic answer.



We are interested in your actual thoughts and how you would approach this business.

title: Shopify QA & Implementation Specialist
description:
How to Apply:



Send your application with the exact Subject Line: TEST  



In the body of your message, please include: 



1. Resume Link: A view-accessible link to your resume (Google Drive or Dropbox—ensure permissions are set to ""Anyone with the link can view"").   



2. Technical Summary: A brief 2–3 sentence summary detailing your experience with web/SaaS QA workflows, Chrome DevTools debugging, and working within e-commerce or Shopify environments.   







Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented Shopify QA & Implementation Specialist to join our team in a core, long-term role.



If you are passionate about web optimization, love hunting down subtle bugs before users ever see them, and want to work directly alongside the core team building the future of e-commerce personalization, this is for you.



About the Role

In this role, you will be the final line of defense for the merchant experiences built on our platform. You will be responsible for reviewing, validating, and testing completed platform implementations, experience builds, feature developments, and bug fixes before they go live to thousands of leading e-commerce brands.   



While your primary focus will be quality assurance and validation, you will also step in to build select platform experiences and handle configuration updates based on merchant needs. You will work side by side with our Development, Support, and Customer Success teams to keep our platform running flawlessly. 



What You’ll Be Doing

- Ensure Flawless Quality: Review and test completed experience builds, feature tickets, and bug fixes against functional, visual, responsive (mobile/desktop), and edge-case requirements.   

- Identify & Document Issues: Pinpoint defects and write clear, actionable reports complete with reproduction steps, actual vs. expected behavior, and screen recordings or screenshots.   

- Collaborate & Verify: Partner directly with our developers to resolve bugs and re-verify fixes prior to official release.   

- Hands-on Configuration: Implement select user-requested changes and configure web experiences directly within the platform.   

- Maintain High Standards: Keep communication tight across support, customer success, and dev teams to ensure quick turnaround times without compromising quality. 



What We’re Looking For

Requirements:

- 1+ years of experience in web implementation, quality assurance, platform configuration, or web content management.   

- HTML & CSS Proficiency: You know your way around web code and can read and tweak structures easily.   

- Ticketing Systems: Comfortable using tools like Jira, HubSpot, Zendesk, or Freshdesk to track and document tasks.   

- Attention to Detail: Excellent functional, visual, responsive, and regression testing skills.   

- Clear Communication: Strong written and spoken English skills to clearly document technical issues and collaborate across teams.   

- Work Setup & Availability: A dedicated quiet workspace with a stable 100+ Mbps internet connection, and flexibility across shift times (morning, mid, or night shifts) to support continuous operations.   



Nice-to-Haves:

- Experience with e-commerce, personalization, CMS, or A/B testing/CRO platforms.   

- Direct hands-on experience with Shopify stores or themes.   

- Familiarity with JavaScript and web browser Developer Tools (Chrome DevTools) for basic troubleshooting.

Kingfisher Ads is a US paid-social agency. We run Meta 
 and Instagram) ads for golf brands. We have lots of creator footage and ads that already work. We're looking for an editor who can find the story in that footage.

You'll get raw clips from several creators. We want to see you pick the right hook, put the clips in an order that builds, and cut it so it keeps moving without feeling rushed. Every cut should feel natural. We'd take a simple edit with a great story over a flashy edit with a weak one.



WHO YOU ARE

 or Instagram.

- You adapt fast. What works on social media keeps shifting, and you enjoy keeping up.

- Instagram is part of your daily routine. Our ads need to look like they belong in the feed, so this one is a must.

- GOLF KNOWLEDGE IS A BIG PLUS. Tell us if you're a golf fan, understand the game, or have edited for a golf brand before. It isn't required, but it will set you apart.



TOOLS

DAY TO DAY

- Edit creator (UGC) footage into short ads for
 and Instagram (Reels, Stories and Feed).

- Deliver on time, every time. Our launch dates don't move.

- Notice what's catching on in the feed and share ideas with the team.

 or Instagram. Tell us what you did on each.

 what order to put clips in?

Apply > trial task > video call > first paid project.

title: Litigation Paralegal
description:
About us



We're a plaintiff personal injury firm. We handle catastrophic injury, trucking and commercial vehicle crashes, wrongful death, premises liability and medical malpractice. We have a few hundred open files and we're still growing. A former district judge and a former prosecutor run the firm, so we care a lot about honesty in how we report time, deadlines and mistakes.



What the job is



You take the file once suit is filed and carry it through trial prep. You know where every case stands and what's due next. Day to day, that means:



Pleadings: petitions, amended petitions and service

Discovery: interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, discovery responses, and defendants' written discovery questionnaires

Records and damages: records requests, business records affidavits, Section 18.001 affidavits, and watching for counter-affidavits

Experts: lining up experts, collecting reports and filing designations

Depositions: notices, subpoenas and exhibits, plus coordination with opposing counsel, court reporters and clients

Deadlines: calendaring the docket control order and tracking every deadline on every file

Mediation and trial prep: mediation packets, exhibit and witness lists, and pretrial filings



You'll work every day with the attorney, the case manager and the legal assistant on your team. There's no training period.



What we're looking for

At least one year of plaintiff personal injury litigation on filed cases

Working knowledge of Texas civil procedure

Daily use of case management software across a heavy caseload

The habit of telling the attorney bad news early



We don't hire people who pad their hours. This has to be your only job.



Working remote

A private workspace and internet reliable enough for depositions and client calls, with backup internet and backup power

Online during Central Time business hours, on camera for team meetings, and responsive on chat

Time logged by task as you go

Firm files stay in firm systems

Hours and pay



The job is 40 hours a week, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time. In Manila, that's 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. from mid-March to early November, and 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. the rest of the year.



The rate is $6.00 to $10.00 per hour in U.S. dollars, as an independent contractor, based on your tested experience. Discretionary bonuses are available. Include your full ask in your application: rate, PTO, holidays, allowances and payment method.



Screening questions



Answer each one in a few sentences, in your own words. We care more about how you think than about polished writing.



A docket control order arrives with a trial setting eight months out. What goes on the calendar first, and how do you work backward from trial?

A defendant was served 24 days ago and there's no answer on file. What do you check, and what do you tell the attorney?

The defense serves a counter-affidavit to your client's Section 18.001 affidavit. What do you do that day, and what does it change about the case?

Expert designations are due Friday. The expert hasn't sent a CV or report, and the last provider's records haven't come in. What do you do, and in what order?

It's Monday. You have discovery responses due today, a deposition tomorrow with exhibits that aren't final, an upset client on the phone, and an attorney who wants an amended petition by Wednesday. How do you order that list, and why?

You realize a deadline on one of your files passed last week. What do you do in the next hour?



In your application, also confirm your rate and whether you work for anyone else now.

title: Conversational DM Setter | You Reply, You Qualify, You Book | Part-Time 4h/day
description:
We are looking for a senior LinkedIn appointment setter to join one of the most exciting companies in the AI video production industry. If you are experienced, sharp, and you love turning conversations into booked calls, keep reading, this could be the role you have been waiting for.



READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific instructions at the bottom, and only complete applications are reviewed.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION. We are looking for an experienced, seasoned LinkedIn appointment setter.



>> ABOUT XTENDENCY.AI



Xtendency.ai is an AI video production company. We help businesses internalize AI video production across multiple verticals, such as system installation and team training. Our clients are worldwide: Europe, the Middle East, North America and Australia. The company comes from a luxury production background.



- Agency website: 

- Academy website: 



Please note: these websites are here as reference only, to show you what we do. Do not book anything through them. The entire recruitment process is handled here on OnlineJobs.ph.



You will work on the two founders' LinkedIn accounts.



>> THE ROLE



You run the LinkedIn conversations on both founder accounts, qualify the people who reply, and book the qualified ones into calls.



This is not the usual LinkedIn VA job. We are NOT looking for lead generation, prospect research, list building, scraping or Sales Navigator work. All of that is already in place. Our lists are built, our campaigns run on automation software, and replies arrive every single day.



Your job is the conversations. People reply, you answer. You answer quickly and naturally, like a real human being. You qualify each prospect against our checklist, you follow up consistently, and you book the qualified ones. Important: no AI is allowed in this job. Every message is written by you, personally.



Everything is already built: scripts, qualification criteria, objection handling, landing pages, video training library, testimonials, resources. The system works, and we are scaling it for the long term. We need an experienced professional to run it every day.



The role can evolve: live qualification calls may enter the system over time, and for the right person that is a real opportunity to grow.



>> WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Handle the inbox on both founder LinkedIn accounts: read, tag, reply, follow up

- Send high volumes of conversational messages: around 100 per account per day, roughly 200 per day in total

- Qualify prospects against our checklist before booking anything

- Follow up on stalled conversations. This is where most bookings actually come from.

- Update the CRM the same day, every day. Every conversation logged and tagged.

- Log your numbers in our shared tracker

- Send a short end-of-day report to the founders



>> HARD REQUIREMENTS



1. Experience: minimum 2 years appointment setting, minimum 1 year on LinkedIn specifically



Two years minimum in appointment setting, with at least one of those years in LinkedIn DM setting specifically: real back-and-forth conversations that end in a booked call. Tell us exactly where you did it and for what kind of offer.



The role today is conversational DM setting. Experience with phone qualification calls or cold calling in English is a strong bonus and will be highly taken into account.



2. A working, fast computer



A reliable laptop or desktop that you own and control. This is computer-based work, and solid general computer literacy is expected. You will be asked for a photo of your workstation.



3. A stable, strong internet connection



Fibre, 50 Mbps or more. You must be able to join video calls with the team and with clients, with clean audio and video, and you must be able to share your screen. Send a Speedtest screenshot taken where you will usually work. A mobile hotspot as backup is expected.



4. Stable electricity, non-negotiable



We only take candidates with stable electricity. Describe your backup plan in case the power goes out: UPS, generator, or a co-working space you can reach quickly.



5. Bilingual-level English, written and spoken



Written English at a professional level. Spoken English that is clear, with an accent that is easy to understand for the whole team and for clients. We assess both on your video application and on a live call.



6. Full dedication during working hours



We are looking for someone fully dedicated to the company during their working hours, with no other job at the same time. Those hours may increase over time as the role grows.



7. Time and activity tracking



Time and activity tracking software runs during working hours. You log in when your shift begins and log out when it finishes.



8. Tools you must already know how to use



- LinkedIn: deep, practical working knowledge of DMs and conversations

- A CRM: daily logging and tagging

- Google Workspace: Sheets, Docs, Drive

- Notion

- Zoom and Google Meet: join, present and share your screen without assistance



Experience with LinkedIn outreach software (Lemlist, Dripify, La Growth Machine, Expandi, Waalaxy, HeyReach or similar) is strongly preferred. Tell us which ones and what you did with them.



9. Professional presentation on camera



We hold a premium standard in this company. During calls with the founders and, when relevant, with clients, we require a professional presentation and a professional demeanor. We also have an absolute camera-on policy: there are no calls without the camera on.



>> WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Disciplined and consistent. On time, every day, without being asked. Consistency is the entire job.

- Honest and transparent in the collaboration, especially on technical issues or anything that affects the work.

- Organised and systematic. Proper tracking, proper tagging, proper notes, updated the same day.

- Confident at following up. Most bookings come from the third, fourth or fifth message, not the first.

- Comfortable following a script and a process, and street-smart enough to think outside it when that is what gets the appointment booked.

- A fast learner. Onboarding is one structured week, and we expect the role to be learned within it.

- Socially aware, with a real human understanding of people, prospects and clients.



>> WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A real base salary from day one, on a monthly contract

- Complete onboarding by the founders: video training library, scripts, qualification frameworks, objection handling, positioning

- A working system: active campaigns with strong response rates, high-converting landing pages, video testimonials, and two founder accounts with real authority

- All tools provided and paid for

- Direct access to the founders, every day

- A long-term role in a company scaling in a fast-growing market



You do not need to already understand AI production. We will train you on the offer, the positioning and the objections personally.



>> COMPENSATION



- Base: $550 USD per month, around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday

- Plus 3% commission on sales generated from the calls you book, paid when the client pays. Our programs sell between $2,500 and $10,000, so one single closed sale adds $75 to $300 to your month.

- Realistic total at full speed: $625 to $850 per month. For a 4-hour role, that is top-of-market pay in the Philippines, and it is deliberate. We want to be the job you prioritize.



Hours: around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday. Monday to Friday is your main setting time, and Saturday is a shorter one focused on reactivation messages. Your daily hours sit in a fixed window, morning or afternoon Philippine time, agreed at interview based on the team's coverage needs and your availability, and they stay fixed once agreed.



>> HOW TO APPLY



Your application has two parts. Part one is written. Part two is a short video. 

Both are required for the application to be complete.



PART ONE, IN WRITING

Question 1: Look at 
.

>> A FINAL WORD



We are looking for a strong candidate who wants to grow inside the company. Xtendency.ai has a serious work ethic and a kind, professional environment, and this is a key role in it: a professional we can rely on completely, pay properly, and grow with as the company scales.



What matters most to us: honesty, discipline, consistency, fast learning, and a real human understanding of people. The offer and the scripts, we will train you on.



If that is you, apply carefully and completely. We will be very happy to meet you.



Xtendency.ai

title: Senior LinkedIn Appointment Setter | Replies & Booking Only | 4h/day | up to $760/mo
description:
We are looking for a rockstar LinkedIn appointment setter to join one of the most exciting companies in the AI video production industry. If you are experienced, sharp, and you love turning conversations into booked calls, keep reading, this could be the role you have been waiting for.



READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific instructions at the bottom, and only complete applications are reviewed.



THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION. We are looking for an experienced, seasoned LinkedIn appointment setter.



>> ABOUT XTENDENCY.AI



Xtendency.ai is an AI video production company. We help businesses internalize AI video production across multiple verticals, such as system installation and team training. Our clients are worldwide: Europe, the Middle East, North America and Australia. The company comes from a luxury production background.



- Agency website: 

- Academy website: 



Please note: these websites are here as reference only, to show you what we do. Do not book anything through them. The entire recruitment process is handled here on OnlineJobs.ph.



You will work on the two founders' LinkedIn accounts.



>> THE ROLE



You run the LinkedIn conversations on both founder accounts, qualify the people who reply, and book the qualified ones into calls.



This is not the usual LinkedIn VA job. We are NOT looking for lead generation, prospect research, list building, scraping or Sales Navigator work. All of that is already in place. Our lists are built, our campaigns run on automation software, and replies arrive every single day.



Your job is the conversations. People reply, you answer. You answer quickly and naturally, like a real human being. You qualify each prospect against our checklist, you follow up consistently, and you book the qualified ones. Important: no AI is allowed in this job. Every message is written by you, personally.



Everything is already built: scripts, qualification criteria, objection handling, landing pages, video training library, testimonials, resources. The system works, and we are scaling it for the long term. We need an experienced professional to run it every day.



The role can evolve: live qualification calls may enter the system over time, and for the right person that is a real opportunity to grow.



>> WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



- Handle the inbox on both founder LinkedIn accounts: read, tag, reply, follow up

- Send high volumes of conversational messages: around 100 per account per day, roughly 200 per day in total

- Qualify prospects against our checklist before booking anything

- Follow up on stalled conversations. This is where most bookings actually come from.

- Update the CRM the same day, every day. Every conversation logged and tagged.

- Log your numbers in our shared tracker

- Send a short end-of-day report to the founders



>> HARD REQUIREMENTS



1. Experience: minimum 2 years appointment setting, minimum 1 year on LinkedIn specifically



Two years minimum in appointment setting, with at least one of those years in LinkedIn DM setting specifically: real back-and-forth conversations that end in a booked call. Tell us exactly where you did it and for what kind of offer.



The role today is conversational DM setting. Experience with phone qualification calls or cold calling in English is a strong bonus and will be highly taken into account.



2. A working, fast computer



A reliable laptop or desktop that you own and control. This is computer-based work, and solid general computer literacy is expected. You will be asked for a photo of your workstation.



3. A stable, strong internet connection



Fibre, 50 Mbps or more. You must be able to join video calls with the team and with clients, with clean audio and video, and you must be able to share your screen. Send a Speedtest screenshot taken where you will usually work. A mobile hotspot as backup is expected.



4. Stable electricity, non-negotiable



We only take candidates with stable electricity. Describe your backup plan in case the power goes out: UPS, generator, or a co-working space you can reach quickly.



5. Bilingual-level English, written and spoken



Written English at a professional level. Spoken English that is clear, with an accent that is easy to understand for the whole team and for clients. We assess both on your video application and on a live call.



6. Full dedication during working hours



We are looking for someone fully dedicated to the company during their working hours, with no other job at the same time. Those hours may increase over time as the role grows.



7. Time and activity tracking



Time and activity tracking software runs during working hours. You log in when your shift begins and log out when it finishes.



8. Tools you must already know how to use



- LinkedIn: deep, practical working knowledge of DMs and conversations

- A CRM: daily logging and tagging

- Google Workspace: Sheets, Docs, Drive

- Notion

- Zoom and Google Meet: join, present and share your screen without assistance



Experience with LinkedIn outreach software (Lemlist, Dripify, La Growth Machine, Expandi, Waalaxy, HeyReach or similar) is strongly preferred. Tell us which ones and what you did with them.



9. Professional presentation on camera



We hold a premium standard in this company. During calls with the founders and, when relevant, with clients, we require a professional presentation and a professional demeanor. We also have an absolute camera-on policy: there are no calls without the camera on.



>> WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Disciplined and consistent. On time, every day, without being asked. Consistency is the entire job.

- Honest and transparent in the collaboration, especially on technical issues or anything that affects the work.

- Organised and systematic. Proper tracking, proper tagging, proper notes, updated the same day.

- Confident at following up. Most bookings come from the third, fourth or fifth message, not the first.

- Comfortable following a script and a process, and street-smart enough to think outside it when that is what gets the appointment booked.

- A fast learner. Onboarding is one structured week, and we expect the role to be learned within it.

- Socially aware, with a real human understanding of people, prospects and clients.



>> WHAT WE PROVIDE



- A real base salary from day one, on a monthly contract

- Complete onboarding by the founders: video training library, scripts, qualification frameworks, objection handling, positioning

- A working system: active campaigns with strong response rates, high-converting landing pages, video testimonials, and two founder accounts with real authority

- All tools provided and paid for

- Direct access to the founders, every day

- A long-term role in a company scaling in a fast-growing market



You do not need to already understand AI production. We will train you on the offer, the positioning and the objections personally.



>> COMPENSATION



- Base: $550 USD per month, around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday

- Plus 3% commission on sales generated from the calls you book, paid when the client pays. Our programs sell between $2,500 and $10,000, so one single closed sale adds $75 to $300 to your month.

- Realistic total at full speed: $625 to $850 per month. For a 4-hour role, that is top-of-market pay in the Philippines, and it is deliberate. We want to be the job you prioritize.



Hours: around 20 hours a week, Monday to Saturday. Monday to Friday is your main setting time, and Saturday is a shorter one focused on reactivation messages. Your daily hours sit in a fixed window, morning or afternoon Philippine time, agreed at interview based on the team's coverage needs and your availability, and they stay fixed once agreed.



>> HOW TO APPLY



Your application has two parts. Part one is written. Part two is a short video. 

Both are required for the application to be complete.



PART ONE, IN WRITING



1. Start your application with the word "MANGO" in capital letters. It simply tells us you read the post. Otherwise your application will not be taken into account in our system.



2. Answer these two questions in your own words:



Question 1: Look at 
. 

In 3 to 5 sentences, in your own words: what do you think we help people do?



Question 2: A prospect has told you twice that our program looks interesting. On your third message you ask to book a 15-minute call. He replies: "Honestly I'm fully booked until next month, let's talk then." Write the exact message you would send back, word for word, as you would really send it. One message only.



3. Your experience, in short and precise points:



- How many years of appointment setting, and for which companies or clients

- How many of those years on LinkedIn specifically

- What offers you were setting for, and at what price point

- Which outreach or conversational tools you have used

- How many messages you were sending per day at your busiest

- How many conversations you were handling at the same time at your busiest

- Your internet setup and your power backup plan, in one or two lines

- Every job, client or commitment you currently have, with the hours. Write "None" if you have none.

- One line confirming you understand this role is conversational: no lead generation, no scraping, no list building



4. Attach three documents:



- Your CV

- A Speedtest screenshot, taken where you will usually work

- A photo of your workstation, taken with your phone



PART TWO, THE VIDEO



Record a video of yourself, 1 to 2 minutes, face on camera. Keep it simple and natural:



- Introduce yourself: who you are, your hobbies, what you enjoy doing

- Tell us about your appointment setting experience in your own words



You can record it with a free tool like Loom (
): it records you from your browser and gives you a link to paste into your application. Any similar tool works, as long as we can see and hear you clearly.



We use this video for two things: your spoken English and your personality. We are looking for someone engaging, with energy. No script needed, just talk to us.



>> WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review your application, your video and your attachments.

2. Selected candidates have a 30-minute video call with the founders.

3. We ask for one previous employer contact for a reference call.

4. Shortlisted candidates start with a one-week onboarding, followed by a one-week trial on real conversations.



>> AUTOMATIC REJECTION



X No presentation video

X No photo of the workstation

X No Speedtest screenshot

X The application does not start with MANGO

X Less than 2 years appointment setting experience

X Applications pitching lead generation, scraping or research services

X Generic, copy-pasted or AI-written text with nothing personal in it

X An unclear situation regarding other jobs and clients



>> A FINAL WORD



We are looking for a strong candidate who wants to grow inside the company. Xtendency.ai has a serious work ethic and a kind, professional environment, and this is a key role in it: a professional we can rely on completely, pay properly, and grow with as the company scales.



What matters most to us: honesty, discipline, consistency, fast learning, and a real human understanding of people. The offer and the scripts, we will train you on.



If that is you, apply carefully and completely. We will be very happy to meet you.



Xtendency.ai

title: 7+ Years B2B Sales Rep | Closer
description:
Part-Time | 10 Hours/Week Initially | $7/Hour + 7% Commission



Looking for a proven full-cycle B2B salesperson who can independently build pipeline, develop opportunities, close business, and secure payment.



WHAT YOU WILL SELL



You will sell the Workplace Burnout Review.



The Workplace Burnout Review is a $9,500, three-week advisory engagement that identifies the workplace conditions contributing to burnout and provides leadership with a tailored 90-day action plan.



Typical buyers include Directors, Senior Directors, VPs, executives, and other senior leaders responsible for teams, functions, transformation efforts, PMOs, or business units.



YOU WILL



• Build and manage your own B2B sales pipeline

• Conduct targeted outreach to senior business decision-makers

• Move opportunities through the full sales cycle independently

• Close business and secure client payment



LOOKING FOR



• 7+ years of direct B2B sales experience

• Proven responsibility for personally closing B2B business

• Experience independently building and managing your own pipeline

• Experience managing the full sales cycle from prospecting through close

• Evidence of individual closed revenue, quota attainment, or measurable sales results

• Experience selling higher-value B2B services, professional services, or solutions

• Experience selling to Directors, VPs, executives, or other senior business decision-makers

• Strong written and spoken English

• Ability to operate independently with minimal day-to-day supervision



Experience selling consulting, advisory services, HR solutions, leadership services, organizational development, transformation services, or similar B2B offerings is especially relevant.



This is not a lead-generation, appointment-setting, sales-support, or customer-service role. You must have personally closed B2B business.



COMPENSATION



In addition to $7/hour, you will earn 7% of collected client revenue on every sale you source and close.



SCHEDULE



10 hours per week initially, with the opportunity to increase based on demonstrated sales performance and pipeline development.

Please answer all three questions and number your responses 1–3.



1. How many years have you personally been responsible for closing B2B sales? What did you sell, what was the typical deal value, and who were the buyers?



2. Describe one B2B sale you personally sourced and closed from initial outreach through buyer commitment or payment. State the approximate deal value and your role in the sale.



3. What measurable individual sales results can you provide, such as closed revenue, number of deals closed, quota attainment, or sales growth?



Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be considered.

title: Operations & Finance Specialist for Ad Agency (Xero Experience Required)
description:
Company: Kingfisher Ads, a US-based advertising agency specializing in Google and Meta ads for the golf industry



About us



We run paid advertising for golf brands. Small team, direct communication, no corporate fluff. We move fast and we want to automate everything worth automating.



Why this role is different



Most ops roles are about doing the tasks. This one is about owning them and making them better.



You'd own the processes that keep the agency running: client onboarding, reporting workflows, hiring admin, our new creator program, and the monthly finances. We care as much about how you improve these processes as how well you run them.



We use AI a lot (Claude especially) and we're building more automation into how we work (Zapier, n8n). You won't be expected to build complex automations alone, that's a team effort, but you should be the person spotting what's worth automating, helping set it up, and handling the exceptions once it's running. If you're the type who asks "why are we still doing this by hand?", you'll do well here.



If you've worked at an ad agency before, you already know the work we're talking about: client reporting, onboarding, campaign admin, the monthly rhythm of it all. If you've improved or automated processes around any of that, especially reporting, you're exactly who we're looking for.



What you'd own



Operations (most of your time)



- Improving our recurring processes and helping automate the ones worth automating, client reporting workflows are a big one

- Building and running client onboarding checklists in ClickUp

- Screening job applicants against our criteria before they reach us

- Documenting SOPs across the agency

- Tracking software subscriptions and flagging waste

- Contractor payment admin as our freelance team grows



Content creator program (new, you'd help build it)



We're building a roster of golf content creators for client campaigns. Creators apply through our website, and you'd help run the program from the ground up:



- Screening inbound creator applications and keeping the creator database current (rates, availability, content styles, past performance)

- Managing creator relationships day to day: coordinating briefs, deadlines, and deliverables across campaigns

- Tracking creator payments alongside the rest of contractor payment admin



Lead generation support



- Building and cleaning prospect lists of golf brands and businesses that fit our ideal client profile

- Keeping the CRM organized and up to date

- Researching prospects before sales calls



Finance (smaller in hours, non-negotiable in skill)



This is the part that has to be done right every month, and it's why Xero experience is a hard requirement:



- Monthly bookkeeping and bank reconciliations in Xero

- Client billing prep: pulling ad spend from Google and Meta, calculating fees, staging invoices

- Completing our monthly cash flow tracking spreadsheet and recommending improvements to how we categorize and track

- Moving clients onto automated payments (ACH)

- A short monthly financial summary: revenue by client, spending trends, anything we should look at



Being "familiar with Xero" isn't enough for this role. We need someone who has owned the month-end process themselves, reconciliations done, everything coded, reports checked, and who stands behind their own numbers.



Requirements



- 2+ years of bookkeeping experience with Xero, including owning the month-end process. This is a hard requirement

- Experience working with US-based businesses

- Strong written English

- Detail-obsessed. Reconciliations that are almost right are wrong

- Comfortable learning new tools quickly

- Own computer, stable internet, and a backup plan for power or internet outages

- Available for a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time (most of the work is flexible)



Big bonuses



- Experience working at or with an advertising or marketing agency, especially on client reporting

- Direct experience managing or supporting ad campaigns (Google, Meta)

- Zapier or n8n experience

- ClickUp or similar PM tool experience

- Daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) in your work

- Experience working with influencers or content creators



Pay



Includes 13th month pay. Full time, long-term role. Salary as listed, paid monthly.



Hiring process



Shortlisted candidates will do a short video interview followed by a paid test task. We respect your time and won't ask for free work.



How to apply



Start your application with the word KINGFISHER so we know you read this post.



Then answer these three questions. Applications without answers to all three will not be considered:



1. Describe a repetitive task you automated in a previous role. What tool did you use and what was the result?

2. What's a common mistake you see in how small businesses track cash flow?

3. Walk us through your month-end process in Xero, step by step. What do you check before you consider the month done?



Include the types of US businesses you've done bookkeeping for, and mention any agency or ad management experience.

title: Scheduling Coordinator – US Home Care Agency (Remote, US Eastern Hours)
description:
About us

We're a 16-year-old, ACHC-accredited home care agency in New Jersey, USA, providing in-home care to seniors, including clients living with dementia. Our caregivers are the heart of the business, and scheduling is what keeps them and our clients connected. We're adding a full-time Scheduling Coordinator to our operations team.



Schedule:

Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (approximately 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM Philippine Time). Consistent availability during these hours is required. This role also includes on-call coverage every weekend, handling caregiver call-outs, urgent scheduling changes, and caregiver and family calls, with escalation to our US-based management team as needed.



What you'll do:

Build and maintain weekly caregiver schedules, matching caregivers to clients by skills, availability, and location

Fill call-outs and open shifts quickly, keeping clients informed

Monitor electronic visit verification (EVV) and resolve missed or late clock-ins the same day

Communicate daily with caregivers and families by phone, text, and
, professionally and warmly

Support caregiver recruiting: post ads, conduct first-round phone screens, schedule interviews, and track credentials and certifications

Provide weekend on-call coverage, resolving scheduling issues independently and escalating urgent client matters to our US team

Coordinate closely with our after-hours coordinator, with clear written handoffs on open items at each shift change

Keep accurate records in our scheduling system and flag scheduling or coverage risks to management



Must-haves:

2+ years of scheduling experience with a US home care, home health, or healthcare staffing company

Availability for every-weekend on-call coverage

Comfort and hands-on familiarity with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for drafting messages, organizing information, and working faster

Fiber internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload, plus a mobile data backup and a UPS or other backup power source

A quiet, noise-controlled home workspace suitable for professional phone calls with elderly clients and families



What we're looking for:

Experience with a home care scheduling platform such as WellSky, AxisCare, AlayaCare, or similar

Excellent spoken and written English; comfortable on the phone with elderly clients and their families

Calm, organized problem-solver who can handle several urgent situations at once

Experience working overnight shifts for US clients

Understanding of patient privacy (HIPAA) and handling confidential information



Nice to have

Caregiver recruiting or HR coordination experience

Familiarity with US geography and drive-time planning



Compensation

$600–1,100 USD per month, paid [monthly/semi-monthly], plus [weekend on-call stipend / on-call compensation included in rate]. Full-time, long-term role with growth opportunity.



To apply

Send your resume, a screenshot of a recent internet speed test, and a short description of your workspace and backup setup. In your note, describe a time you had to fill multiple last-minute call-outs on the same day, and share one specific way you use AI tools in your work. Include the words "Care Schedule" in your subject line.

title: QuickBooks Client Bookkeeper | U.S. Clients | $1,200–$1,400 | 3 Openings
description:
TrueBooks USA provides recurring monthly bookkeeping to U.S. small businesses. We are hiring three Philippines-based Client Bookkeepers. Each bookkeeper will manage an assigned client portfolio, serve as a direct point of contact, and meet clients by video to explain monthly work and answer routine bookkeeping questions.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Categorize and review transactions.

• Reconcile bank and credit-card accounts.

• Document exceptions, missing information, and client questions.

• Prepare draft monthly financial reports for senior review.

• Maintain accurate records and consistently meet monthly-close deadlines.



You will work with a Senior Bookkeeper & Team Lead who reviews your work and helps resolve complex issues.



PORTFOLIO EXPECTATIONS

Your portfolio will ramp gradually. You will not start with 30 clients. Thirty clients is an absolute upper planning limit—not a standard starting or immediate quota. A typical client may have approximately six bank and credit-card accounts, although transaction volume and complexity vary.
